name: Šrégom nočným Zvolenom
organizer: Technická univerzita vo Zvolene, WoodenWorld, Cyklo Zvolen o.z., Mesto Zvolen
description: The Night Run through Zvolen is a night race organized by the student organization Woodenworld at the Technical University in Zvolen and the City of Zvolen. Participants run a 7 km course with an elevation gain of 40 meters, passing through the city of Zvolen and notable sites such as Zvolen Castle, SNP Square, and the Hron River. The event offers electronic timing, refreshments, prizes for top finishers, and a commemorative item. The start is at 8:30 PM in front of the Technical University, and the race is suitable for the general public, including students and university staff.
course_highlights: 7 km course with 40 m elevation gain through Zvolen
Passage around Zvolen Castle and SNP Square
Route along the Hron River ending at the Technical University
additional: Online registration until April 13, 2026, for 12 €, on-site on race day from 6:30 PM to 8:00 PM for 15 €. The registration fee includes a start number, electronic timing, refreshments, prizes, and a commemorative item. Participants under 18 years old race with parental consent. Employees and students of TU Zvolen can specify the "Technical University" club for evaluation of the best TU runners. The race takes place in a night setting, passing through significant Zvolen landmarks. Registration is available online or on-site. Competitions are divided into categories for men and women across various age groups.

name: Priateľský nočný beh mestom Vranov
location: Základná škola Sídlisko II., Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia
description: The friendly night run through the city of Vranov is a traditional running event in Vranov nad Topľou that offers a nocturnal running experience through the city. The race takes place at the premises of the Sídlisko II Elementary School and is open to men, women, and children. The main category starts at 19:30, and the children's run begins at 17:00. The organizers are OZ S rukou v ruke, Sídlisko II Elementary School, the town of Vranov nad Topľou, and OZ Vranovské Vydry, who warmly invite all runners to enjoy a friendly atmosphere and a sporting experience.
course_highlights: Nočný beh mestom Vranov
Štart a cieľ pri Základnej škole Sídlisko II.
Kategórie pre mužov, ženy a deti
additional: Detský beh štartuje o 17:00 hod. Štartovné na mieste je 20 €. Nočná trať, registrácia online a na mieste, detský beh, štafetové behy

name: Beh Galantou – Beh oslobodenia
price_range: 15 € online, 12 € s GALAkartou; štafeta 40 € online, 32 € s GALAkartou; Samsung Run 10 €, 8 € s GALAkartou
description: Galantou Run - Liberation Run is a jubilee 40th edition of a traditional running event in Galanta, offering various disciplines for all age categories. The event is intended not only for athletes but also for everyone who wants to experience an atmosphere full of emotions, joy of movement, and self-overcoming. Each participant will receive a commemorative medal, hydration, and refreshments; children will additionally get a ticket to Water World Galandia and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The best runners will receive monetary rewards and valuable prizes, including televisions in special categories. After the run, a cultural program will be held at the City Cultural Center in Galanta.
course_highlights: Courses for beginners and advanced runners
Commemorative medal for every participant including children
More than 40 valuable prizes in the final raffle
additional: Registration opens on the day of the event at 8:00 AM and closes 20 minutes before the start of each category. Children will receive a ticket to Water World Galandia and a package from COOP Jednota Galanta. The top runners will receive valuable polished glass instead of trophies. Winners of special categories must hold a GalaKARTA. After the run, a cultural program will be held at the City Cultural Center. The event includes various disciplines, rewards, refreshments, and cultural activities. Registration is online, and street closures are expected during the races.

name: Ultramaratón Košice – Miskolc
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: The Košice - Miskolc Ultramarathon is a challenging international ultramarathon race taking place on April 18, 2026. The route runs from the center of Košice to Miskolc, offering runners a challenge with long and diverse terrain. The event is part of a series of running events organized by the Košice Marathon Club and is intended for endurance runners seeking a unique experience at the edge of their capabilities. The start is on Main Street in Košice, which adds a historic atmosphere to the race and support from local spectators.
course_highlights: The route runs from Košice to Miskolc through various terrains
Start and finish in the historic center of Košice on Main Street
International character of the race with crossing borders
additional: The race starts on Main Street in Košice between the DoubleTree by Hilton hotel and the Dargov department store. The event is part of the Košice Marathon series and organized by the Košice Marathon Club. Specific information about start waves, capacities, or fees is not provided. The race begins at 6:00 and 7:00, with registration deadlines and fees set. The race takes place on Main Street and Dolná brána in Košice, intended for runners aged 16 and older. Categories include individual, pairs, and relay teams.

name: Ultramaratón Miškolc - Košice
organizer: Marathon Club Miskolc, Košice Marathon Club
description: Ultramarathon Košice - Miskolc is a prestigious running event taking place on April 18, 2026. Participants run from Košice to Miskolc, covering a challenging ultramarathon route. The event is part of a rich running calendar in the region and offers a unique experience for endurance runners. The organizer is the Košice Marathon Club, which ensures professional preparation and organization.
course_highlights: Ultramarathon route from Košice to Miskolc
Challenging terrain requiring endurance and fitness
Crossing two countries - Slovakia and Hungary
additional: The event is part of a series of running events in Košice, including the International Peace Marathon and other accompanying activities. Organizers offer opportunities to participate as a volunteer, driver, or pacer. Runners have access to comprehensive organizational support and benefits associated with the entry fee. The route passes through cycle paths and has low traffic, with categories for individuals, two-person, five-person, and ten-person relays; start times are at 6:00 and 7:00.

name: BoleRuN
location: areál TJ Slavoj Boleráz, Boleráz, Slovakia
description: BoleRuN is a running event held at the TJ Slavoj Boleráz premises, offering courses for various age groups including children, youth, and adults. Participants can compete on distances from 50 meters up to 10 km, with the children's race starting at 1:00 PM and the adults' race at 2:00 PM. The organizer is the municipality of Boleráz in cooperation with the initiative Boleráz - Hýb sa. The event is suitable for all runners aged 9 and above who want to enjoy a sports day in a pleasant environment.
course_highlights: Adult course 10 km and 5 km
Youth course for ages 10 to 14 - 2 km
Children's course up to 9 years old from 50 meters to 1 km
additional: Children's race starts at 1:00 PM, adults' race starts at 2:00 PM. Categories are divided by age and distance. The organizer is the municipality of Boleráz and the initiative Boleráz - Hýb sa. Registration is likely closed as of April 2024; the event includes categories for children and adults, with electronic timing and a participant medal.

name: Šarišská míľa
description: The Šariš Mile is a running event organized by BK ZasRun in Šarišské Bohdanovce at the football field. The race is intended for various age categories including children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking. The start is divided into a children's mile, running, and Nordic Walking for women and men, with participation in the race free of charge and an option for a voluntary contribution during registration. The event offers a pleasant atmosphere for runners of all levels and age groups.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the football field in Šarišské Bohdanovce
Categories for children, youth, adults, and Nordic Walking
Start divided into a children's mile, running, and Nordic Walking for women and men
additional: Participation in the race is free of charge, with an option for a voluntary contribution during registration. The children's mile starts at 16:00, women’s running and Nordic Walking at 16:20, men’s running and Nordic Walking at 16:45. Categories are divided by age and gender, including overall standings for Nordic Walking. The race begins at 16:00, is open to the general public, and suitable for all age groups.

name: Chlieb náš….
description: Our Bread is a craft bakery in Hronský Beňadik that produces sourdough bread using traditional methods from quality ingredients. It is committed to honest baking work, which is reflected in a crispy crust, lively sourdough, and soft interior of the bread. The bakery offers an authentic experience where you can choose fresh bread directly from the oven. In addition to the quality of the bread, the bakery is also known for its unique Baroque ceiling, which is one of the most original in Trnava.
course_highlights: Traditional baking of sourdough bread from quality ingredients
Crispy crust and soft interior of the bread
Unique Baroque ceiling in the bakery
additional: The bakery is open Tuesday to Friday from 7:00 AM to 4:00 PM and Saturday from 7:00 AM to 11:30 AM, or until supplies last. The operation emphasizes honest craftsmanship and the family character of Trnka Gastronomy. The event is associated with traditional bread baking, organized at Dumas bakery in Hronský Beňadik, suitable for all interested in baking crafts.

name: Beh oslobodenia Turčianska Štiavnička
description: The Turčianska Štiavnička Liberation Run is a traditional race with a rich history, held to commemorate the anniversary of the village's liberation by the Soviet Army. This 32nd edition will take place on April 18, 2026, at the football pitch in Turčianska Štiavnička. The course, approximately 10 km long, mainly traverses mountain terrain and offers runners a challenging yet beautiful experience. Participants are divided into age categories, including children's categories and the best Štiavničans. Organizers welcome all runners and look forward to their participation.
course_highlights: The course mainly runs through mountain terrain with forest paths and a local park
Distance approximately 10 km, known as the 'Štiavnická ten' or 'Štiavnická ten'
Start and finish at the cultural house and football pitch in the village
additional: Online registration is open from April 1, 2026, to April 16, 2026. The race is divided into men's age categories, women's, and children's categories. Starting numbers are traditionally sewn and printed according to the original pattern from Ružomberok and are still used today. Before the race, a ceremonial laying of a wreath at the fallen heroes' memorial takes place. The races start at 10:00 and 13:15, with registration possible from April 1 to April 16, 2026. The event has historical significance and is part of the local sports calendar.

name: Banská Bystrica - Bežíme spolu v Banskej Bystrici
location: Park pod pamätníkom SNP, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
description: Running Together in Banská Bystrica is a running event held in the park under the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica. It offers four courses of different lengths, including a children's run, suitable for the general public including children up to 6 years old. The course is flat with no elevation gain, allowing for an enjoyable run for all age groups. The event supports people with disabilities, with 2 € from each registration fee going towards motivating them to stay active.
course_highlights: Flat courses with no elevation gain
Four courses: 10 km, 5 km, 3 km, and a children's run of 500 m
Start and finish in the park under the SNP Memorial in Banská Bystrica
additional: Support: 2 € from each paid entry fee will go towards supporting people with disabilities. The children's run is intended for children up to 6 years old (born 2020 - 2026) and requires the presence of a legal guardian. The registration fee is valid from April 7, 2026. The course is flat, ensuring an easy race experience. The course is flat, registration is online, the event supports people with health disabilities, and includes information about data usage consent.

name: Polus Tower Run
location: Polus Tower 2, Bratislava-Nové Mesto, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Polus Tower Run is a unique stair running event taking place on April 18, 2026, at the Polus Tower 2 office building in Bratislava. Participants climb the height difference on their own on two courses - a children's course with 4 floors and 116 steps, and an adult main course with 19 floors and 416 steps. Starts are individual at 30-second intervals, and times are measured electronically. The event is organized by the KOTRMELEC Sports Foundation and is conducted according to the current TWA rules.
course_highlights: Adults: 19 floors / 416 steps, length 400 m, elevation +80 m
PHZ (police, firefighters, rescuers): 416 steps / 19 floors, length 400 m, elevation +80 m
Children: 4 floors / 116 steps, length 200 m, elevation +21 m
additional: The children's start is at 11:00, the adults at 11:30. Race results are announced at 13:00. The course surface is 100% paving. Starts are individual at 30-second intervals with electronic timing. Awards are based on age categories for men and women. Stair race, multiple categories, online registration, limited to 300 participants, race for children and adults, various age groups and medals.

name: Národný beh Devín - Bratislava (5.kolo BP SAZ)
description: TIPOS National Run Devín - Bratislava is the oldest sports event in Slovakia with over 100 years of tradition, taking place for the 78th time. Runners will complete an iconic route from the historic Devín Castle to the center of Bratislava, offering a unique atmosphere and a connection between history and sport. The event is suitable for hobby athletes as well as more demanding runners and attracts thousands of participants of various ages each year. The organizer is STaRZ of the city of Bratislava, which provides complete organizational information and registration.
course_highlights: The route goes from Devín Castle to the center of Bratislava
Road race with over 5,000 participants
Historical and iconic running tradition since 1921
additional: Online registration is possible until April 15, 2026, at 20:00. Group registration is available via email hromadne_prihlasky@starz.sk with billing details. A limited edition T-shirt is available for 13 EUR. The start list is available online. The event is organized by STaRZ of the city of Bratislava. The event includes various routes in Devín, registration is available online, and it is part of the Slovak Athletic Federation's running series. Participants can also watch results and statistics on the official websites.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 4. kolo
description: The Bratislava 2-Mile Run is a regular running race over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), held at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. Organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team, it is open to the general public, including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place on-site on race day from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. The competition is part of a series where runners earn points towards a traveling trophy based on categories and performances.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km) at the Kuchajda swimming complex
Registration and check-in at the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration is on-site on race day from 9:30 AM. In case of a tie in points, the better time after applying a coefficient and then shoe size determines the ranking. Participants can earn an extra point for improving their best time of the year. At the end of the year, the two worst months are discarded from the overall results (amnesty). The race takes place on a public road in the Kuchajda area, Bratislava; categories include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans; on-site registration is also available.

name: Beh 2 míle
description: The 2-mile run in Bratislava at Kuchajda is a regular running race over a distance of 2 miles (3.218 km), organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team. Registration and check-in take place directly on-site near the volleyball court from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. The race is open to various age categories including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. The competition is part of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's traveling cup, where finishing times are adjusted according to age coefficients and runners are scored based on participation and performance.
course_highlights: Course length of 2 miles (3.218 km) at Kuchajda swimming area
Registration and start near the volleyball court
Categories for children, juniors, women, men, and veterans
additional: Registration takes place on-site from 9:30 AM at the volleyball court. The competition for the Traveling Cup of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team awards points based on participation and performance, with an option to exempt the two worst participations of the year. In case of a tie in points, age and the best time of the year determine the winner. The race is held at Kuchajda swimming area, Bratislava, with registration from 9:30 AM and start at 10:00 AM. The competition for the Traveling Cup of the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team involves scoring based on points and times, with categories for various age groups.

name: Sačurovská pätnástka – 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej
organizer: Obec Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ Sačurov, MŠ Sačurov
description: Sačurovská pätnástka - 20. Memoriál Heleny Slukovej is a traditional running race held in the village of Sačurov in the Vranov nad Topľou district. The race starts in front of the elementary school building in Sačurov and offers categories for various age groups including children, youth, and adults. The main category starts at 13:00, children at 12:00. The organizers are the village of Sačurov, OZ Sačurov, ZŠ and MŠ Sačurov. The race is suitable for local runners and beginner athletes.
course_highlights: The race takes place in the village of Sačurov in front of the elementary school
Categories from preschool age to seniors over 70 years old
Evaluation of the best runners for the Vranov district
additional: Start fee is paid exclusively online. Men over 70 years and women over 60 years do not pay a start fee. Children's race starts at 12:00, main categories at 13:00. The evaluation of the best runners for the Vranov district is part of the event. The race is part of a community support event, with online registration available and various categories for all age groups.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča
location: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, Slovenská Kajňa, Slovakia
organizer: Obec Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, Bežecká akadémia Marcela Matanina
description: Kajňa Ten - Ján Oslovič Memorial is a traditional running race held in the village of Slovenská Kajňa. The race offers three disciplines: a long run of 10 km, a short run of 3.66 km, and a short Nordic walking of 3.66 km, all starting simultaneously at 13:00. The competition is divided into several age categories for men and women, allowing broad participation of runners of different ages and abilities. The organizer is the company MATORE s.r.o., which ensures quality organization and timing.
course_highlights: Long run of 10 km in the pleasant environment of Slovenská Kajňa
Short run and Nordic walking of 3.66 km with the same start
Multiple age categories for men and women
additional: Registration on-site is possible from 9:30 on race day. The participant limit for adults is 130. All disciplines start simultaneously at 13:00. The event includes multiple categories and age groups, registration is possible online and on-site, the start is scheduled for 13:00, and there are also children's races and accompanying activities.

name: Kajňanská desiatka – Memoriál Jána Osloviča

description: Kajňa Ten - Ján Oslovič Memorial is a running event held in Slovenská Kajňa in front of the Municipal Office building. Runners can choose from courses of 10 km, 4 km, and Nordic Walking with no age restrictions, as well as children's categories. The main category starts at 13:00, and children's races begin at 12:00. The organizers are the Municipality of Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, and Marcel Matanin's Running Academy. The event is part of the POWERGRAF running league Michalovce - Sobrance 2026.
course_highlights: Courses of 10 km, 4 km, and Nordic Walking in Slovenská Kajňa
Start in front of the Municipal Office building
Part of the POWERGRAF running league Michalovce - Sobrance 2026
additional: Children's races start at 12:00. The participant limit is 150. Categories are divided by age and gender, including Nordic Walking. The organizers are the Municipality of Slovenská Kajňa, MATORE s.r.o. Humenné, and Marcel Matanin's Running Academy. Details about registration or entry fees have not yet been published, but it is a significant running event in the region.

name: Oslobodenie Likavka - Beh oslobodenia o Putovný pohár starostu obce Likavka
location: Futbalový štadión Obecného športového klubu v Likavke, Likavka, Ružomberok, Slovakia
description: The Freedom Run for the Mayor's Traveling Cup of Likavka is a traditional running race organized by the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Elementary School with Kindergarten. The race takes place at the Likavka Municipal Sports Club Football Stadium and is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. Competitors include children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age categories. The start for youth is at 10:05 AM, and for adults at 11:40 AM according to the regulations. The event is suitable for the general public and offers an opportunity to test one's strength in the beautiful environment of Likavka.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Likavka Municipal Sports Club Football Stadium
Part of the 2025 Liptov Running League
Categories for children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups
additional: The start for youth is at 10:05 AM, and for adults at 11:40 AM according to the regulations. Categories include children, pupils, juniors, women, and men in various age groups. The organizer is the Likavka Municipal Office and Likavka Elementary School with Kindergarten. The race is part of the 2025 Liptov Running League. The race takes place at the football stadium, registration is possible online and on-site, and the event includes various categories as part of the regional running series.

name: Čadčianska desiatka
description: The Čadčianska Ten is a traditional running race organized by the Kysucké Marathon Club Čadca, the city of Čadca, and the Social Services Center Čadca Žarec. This 30th edition will take place on April 19, 2026, starting at 10:00 AM at the Žarec Housing Estate in Čadca. Runners can look forward to a well-prepared course and a pleasant atmosphere, making it a popular event among the running community in the region. Registration is available online until April 17, 2026, with the option to register on the race day for an increased entry fee.
course_highlights: Traditional running race with a long-standing history
Start and finish at Žarec Housing Estate in Čadca
Race for the Mayor's Cup of Čadca
additional: Registration is also possible on race day with a higher entry fee of €10. Organizers request participants to register even if uncertain about attendance to speed up the check-in process and minimize errors in name entries. If not attending, the name will not be listed in the results. The race takes place on April 19, 2026, at 10:00 AM, with registration open until April 17, 2026. The start and finish are at Žarec Housing Estate. The event is part of a traditional sports event with a rich history.

name: UCM Night Run
description: UCM Night Run is a charity evening run taking place on April 21, 2026, at 8:00 PM on Trinitarian Square in Trnava. Runners will cover a 5-kilometer route through the historic streets of Trnava's city center, offering a unique atmosphere of the 'Little Rome'. The event is open to everyone regardless of performance and aims to unite the community, promote movement, and support those in need. The proceeds from the run will be used to support rehabilitation and treatment for a child with disabilities. The organizers are the city of Trnava, students of FMK UCM, and the main partner CUKROVAR.
course_highlights: 5 km route through the historic streets of Trnava's city center
Evening atmosphere at Trinitarian Square
Charitable event supporting people with disabilities
additional: Program: 16:00 - 19:15 registration, 19:00 guest performances, 19:30 warm-up and route presentation, 20:00 start. Timing is provided by Terminovka. The event collaborates with the APPkA.app application to support people with disabilities. Registration via terminovka.sk, the event includes a charity collection, discussions about the CUKROVAR project, refreshments, and a chill zone with a DJ.

name: Ultra Kras
location: Národný park Slovenský kras, Turni nad Bodvou, Slovakia
description: The Ultra Kras is a mountain ultramarathon with a length of 57 km and an elevation gain of 2400 meters, taking place in the Slovenský Kras National Park. The start and finish are in Turna nad Bodvou, with a time limit of 12 hours. The race is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League and offers a challenging route with several refreshment and control points. Registration for participants takes place the day before the start and on the race day, with a common start at 7:00 AM.
course_highlights: The route passes through Slovenský Kras National Park
Length of 57 km with an elevation gain of +2400 m
Live control stations at refreshment points
additional: Participant registration is on Friday, April 24, 2026, from 18:00 to 22:00 and on Saturday, April 25, 2026, from 5:00 to 6:30. The time limit to reach the finish is 12 hours from the start, i.e., by 19:00. The control point K3 Hačava (30 km) has a time limit of 7.5 hours from the start (by 14:30). Both the start and finish are at the parking lot next to the Hviezda cinema in Turna nad Bodvou. An electronic timer records arrivals at control points and at the finish. The route is 57 km long, with a 12-hour limit. Registration is open on April 24-25, 2026. There are refreshment stations, mandatory equipment, categories for men and women, and the race is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League.

name: Demänovský Štvanec
location: Demänová rezort, Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia
organizer: WinTeam o.z. a Agentúra 8P v spolupráci s Demänová rezort
description: Demänovský Štvanec is a running event designed for both recreational runners and competitive athletes, held in the beautiful nature of Demänovská Valley in Liptovský Mikuláš. The race offers three disciplines: Small Štvanec 5 km, Large Štvanec with TUI 10 km, and children's runs Štvanček. In addition to the sporting experience, participants can enjoy a family atmosphere and supplementary activities at Demänová Resort. The event is part of a weekend full of movement, games, and joy, organized by WinTeam o.z. and Agentúra 8P in cooperation with Demänová Resort.
course_highlights: Courses run through the beautiful nature of Demänovská Valley
Small Štvanec 5 km and Large Štvanec 10 km with time limits of 1:30 and 2:00 hours
Children's runs Štvanček with staggered starts according to age categories
additional: Registration and pickup of start numbers on Friday, 24.04.2026 from 17:00 to 19:00 and on Saturday, 25.04.2026 from 8:00 to 10:00 for children and adults. Timing for adults is provided by VOS-TPK using chips with continuous results publication at www.sportsofttiming.sk. When booking accommodation at Demänová Resort, the start fee is included in the price of the stay. Children's categories start sequentially from 11:00 based on age. The event includes online and on-site registration, categories for different age groups, and family activities and packages with accommodation at Demänová Resort.

name: Prešov Running Series 1. kolo
price_range: 10 eur (detský štart), zľava 2 eurá pre poistencov Dôvery
description: Prešov Running, o.z. warmly invites you to the Prešov Stars Run 2026, which will take place on April 25th in the center of Prešov. This running evening will take you back to the atmosphere of the 90s with music, retro sports fashion, and entertainment. Participants can choose from children's races and courses of 5 and 10 km, accompanied by DJs and a performance by MC Erika. Prešov Stars Run is the first round of the Prešov Running Series 2026, consisting of three separate races in different parts of the city and its surroundings.
course_highlights: Running courses in the city center of Prešov
Music accompaniment by DJs during the run
Retro atmosphere with hits from the 90s and a performance by MC Erika
additional: Dôvera policyholders can enjoy a 2 euro discount on the registration fee (excluding children's races). The discount is non-transferable and cancellations are only possible before the date specified in the regulations. After a warm-up in the style of Cvičme v Rytme with Omnis Vitality, runners will start on courses of 5 and 10 km. The Prešov Running Series 2026 includes three separate races in April, June, and September. The course includes city streets, online registration is available, and the event features a program with music and performances.

name: Gavurky run 2026 + Backyard ultra
description: Gavurky Run 2026 is a running event in Dobra Niva offering various courses including the main race, hobby run, Nordic walking, and Backyard ultra. The race takes place on April 25, 2026, with registration and starts at Námestie SNP. The event is suitable for a wide range of runners including children, hobby runners, and ultramarathoners, with a capacity limited to 400 participants. The organizer is ŠPORTKLUB Dobrá Niva, o.z., which ensures professional organization and timing.
course_highlights: Main race 10.4 km with an elevation gain of 190 m
Backyard ultra course 6.7 km with an elevation gain of 132 m, start at 8:00
Hobby run and Nordic walking course 5.6 km
additional: Registration for Backyard ultra is from 7:00 to 7:30 at Námestie SNP. Registration for the main, hobby run, and Nordic walking is from 8:30 to 10:30. Children have separate runs with free registration on-site. The event capacity is 400 runners. Online registration closes on 24.4.2026 at 12:00 or when the limit is reached. Entry fee can be paid online, via bank transfer, or on-site (for an additional fee). The course includes asphalt and unpaved paths. Registration is possible online and on-site. Participants can choose from three courses: a cross half marathon with an elevation gain of over 1000 meters, a seven-kilometer spa route, and accompanying children's and youth categories. The event is suitable for all runners who enjoy challenging terrain and mountain challenges. Organizers provide refreshments on the course, medals, T-shirts, and other benefits for early registered participants.
course_highlights: Route A: Cross half marathon 22 km with an elevation gain of over 1000 m
Refreshments on Route A at 8 km near Zborovský Castle and at 15 km on Stebnícka Magura (899 m a.s.l.)
Route B: Spa Seven 7 km with an elevation gain of over 180 m
additional: Registration for Route C (children and youth) takes place on-site at the event, with a limit of 80 participants. Runners on Routes A and B are provided with free parking at Bardejovské Kúpele, a race number with chip, T-shirt, refreshments on the course, medal, trophies, prizes, lunch, and a drink after the race. Multiple categories including children and youth, event program on race day, and detailed instructions for participants.

The course is 5 km long and suitable for all age groups, including children and runners with dogs. The event is open to the general public and offers various categories based on age and participant type.

The course length is 5 km with a single lap
Option to run with a dog or with a rescue dog

Categories include men, women, boys and girls up to 15 years old, as well as categories with a dog and a rescue dog. The event aims to support people and dogs in need, registration is possible online, and results are available on the organizer's website.

description: DOBRObeh is a charity run in Čadca offering five different courses, including the main run of Mária Marcibálová with a length of 21.5 km and an elevation gain of 600 m. The course mainly passes through forests, asphalt, and meadows, and is clearly marked and secured by organizers. The event is open to all runners who want to support a good cause, with everyone who runs being a winner. The start is at Palárikova Street near the Rybka fountain in the pedestrian zone in Čadca. In addition to the main run, shorter courses are available, including 10 km, 4.5 km, and children's races.

A charity run without winner evaluation, where everyone who supports DOBRO is a winner. The charity run allows contributions in food or financial donations, with various courses including the 21.5 km run, supporting help for people in need.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Bratislava
description: Wings for Life World Run Bratislava is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants start simultaneously and race against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up to them. The race has no finish line; runners run as long as they are not overtaken by the car. The course passes through Sad Janka Kráľa, one of the oldest parks in Europe, and combines various environments. The event supports spinal cord injury research, with 100% of registration fees going to this cause. The race starts precisely at 13:00.
course_highlights: The course passes through Sad Janka Kráľa, one of the oldest parks in Europe
A combination of different environments over a 2 km course
The virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the start and gradually increases speed
additional: The race is open to both runners and wheelchair participants, who run together. The virtual Catcher Car begins 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h and gradually accelerates until it overtakes all competitors. Participation is only possible via the Wings for Life World Run mobile app. 100% of all registration fees are allocated to spinal cord injury research. Registration is online, the run is supported by the Wings for Life World Run app, and all proceeds go to spinal cord injury research.

name: Wings for Life World APP RUN Nižná Myšľa
description: Wings for Life World Run in Nižná Myšľa is a unique event where runners and wheelchair participants compete against a virtual Catcher Car that gradually catches up to them. The course starts from the archeoskanzen Nižná Myšľa, a well-known archaeological site, and passes through forests, unpaved roads, meadows, and the village, combining asphalt and natural surfaces. The race starts on May 10, 2026, at 1:00 PM, and all registration fees go towards spinal cord injury research. Join runners worldwide and challenge yourself in this global race without a finish line.
course_highlights: The course is 20% on asphalt and 80% on forest and unpaved roads
Start and finish at the archeoskanzen Nižná Myšľa with full facilities and refreshments
The loop passes archaeological sites and scenic landscapes of the Košice Basin and Slanské Hills
additional: The virtual Catcher Car departs 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h and gradually increases its pace until it overtakes all runners. Nordic walking is welcome. Parking, changing rooms, and storage are available at the archeoskanzen. 100% of registration fees are donated to spinal cord injury research. The course includes asphalt, forest roads, and unpaved paths; start at the archeoskanzen, on-site parking, registration via the app.

name: Benefičný beh PRO AUTIS
description: Beneficial Run PRO AUTIS is a charity running event whose proceeds are donated to the Trenčín Autism Center PRO AUTIS. The race takes place in Soblahov near Trenčín and offers various courses including children's runs and distances of 5 km, 10 km, and 13.3 km. The event is open to all runners regardless of age, and organizers emphasize personal achievement and self-improvement. Registration is possible online until May 8, 2026, with the option to register on-site on race day.

Course distances: 5 km, 10 km, 13.3 km, children's runs of 300 m and 800 m, online registration, race bib with chip, health data on the race bib, parking along the road into the village.

The organizer is the Institute of Physical Education at the University of Žilina and OK Žilina, who ensure the smooth running of the event. The registration deadline is May 10, 2026, with additional entries only possible in exceptional cases.

Start at the parking lot under Strečno Castle
Categories for youth, university students, women, and men

Results are available at vysledkovyservis.sk/orungutan. The race starts at a farm below Vtáčnik and refreshments are provided at several points along the route. The organizer emphasizes mandatory equipment and runner safety.
course_highlights: 50 km course with +2000 m elevation gain and a 10-hour time limit
27 km course with +1000 m elevation gain and a 5-hour time limit
8.4 km course with +380 m elevation gain and a 2-hour time limit
additional: On the 50 km route, there are three refreshment stations at 9 km, 27 km, and 44 km. Mandatory equipment includes identification documents, a charged mobile phone, a map or GPX file, a personal folding cup or bottle with a minimum volume of 1.5 dl, a first aid kit (thermal foil, elastic bandage), and at least 0.5 liters of water. The start number must be visibly placed on the front of the body throughout the race. Recommended equipment includes a waterproof jacket in case of rain. Route lengths: 50 km, 27 km, 8 km; elevation gains: +2000 m, +1000 m, +380 m; mandatory equipment, refreshment stations along the routes, time limits of 10, 5, and 2 hours.

name: Petržalská 10
price_range: 20 € (online pred 1. aprílom 2026), 25 € (po, do uzávierky registrácie); deti 6-8 €
description: Petržalská 10 is a popular running race in Bratislava, held at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka. The race offers various categories including a children's run, the main 10 km run, Nordic walking, and a family run with dogs. The children's races start at 10:00 AM and the main run at 11:30 AM. The organizer is Športová Nadácia Kotrmelec, which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The course runs in Bratislava-Petržalka, start and finish at Námestie Republiky
Main 10 km run with categories for men, women, and Nordic walking
Family run with dogs over 1.8 km and children's run over 5 km
additional: Children up to 5 years old and children from child and family centers (CDR) can participate for free. Categories include men and women in various age groups, 5 km Nordic walking, and a family run with dogs over 1.8 km. Multiple categories include 5 km, family run, and Nordic walking; starts at 10:00 AM and 11:30 AM; online registration; venue at Námestie Republiky in Petržalka.

name: Medzinárodný Novohradský Maratón štafety
description: The International Novohrad Marathon Relay is a running relay marathon taking place on May 23, 2026, on a route between the towns of Salgótarján in Hungary and Lučenec in Slovakia. The course is 42.2 km long and divided into four segments run by four relay runners. The race is open to men's, women's, and mixed relays with a minimum ratio of 50% women and 50% men. Refreshment stations are provided along the route, and at the finish line, participants can enjoy goulash, sports cups, and monetary prizes for the best relays. Runners start at 10:00 AM, and registration is possible until May 21, 2026, online or on-site if spots are available.
course_highlights: The route passes through Salgótarján, Šiatorská, Rátka, Rapovce, and Lučenec
The relay has 4 segments: 11 km, 10 km, 10.7 km, and 10.5 km
Refreshments at each relay exchange point and goulash at the finish line
additional: Registration is valid upon payment of the start fee. Capacity is limited to 20 relays. A relay team consists of 4 runners, and relay exchanges are only permitted at designated points. The total course time limit is 4 hours. Strict prohibition of accompaniment on the route (car, bicycle, scooter) for safety reasons. The start is open to runners from 15 years old. The race is run on the left side of the road with full traffic. The event is intended for participants aged 15 and above, emphasizing safety and adherence to rules. The event also includes accompanying cultural activities and online registration.

name: Memoriál Františka Daniša – cezpoľný beh
description: The František Daniš Memorial - Cross Country Race is a running event held in the village of Trstín, Trnava district, on a football pitch. The course mainly runs on a field and grassy path with a partial section of asphalt sidewalk. Various age categories compete, including men, women, juniors, and residents of Trstín, with some categories running two laps. The event is suitable for runners who enjoy natural surfaces and cross country running in the pleasant environment of Trstín.
course_highlights: The course is three-quarters on a field and grassy path
One-quarter of the course is on an asphalt sidewalk
The race takes place on a football pitch in Trstín
additional: Categories are divided by age and gender, some categories run two laps, and residents of Trstín have their own category. Local contacts: Municipality of Trstín, phone 033/558 92 62, email outrstin@slovanet.sk, mayor Peter Hlávek, phone 0918 775 109, email starosta@trstin.sk. The event includes multiple categories and is part of the spring health run, with on-site registration available. Registration can be arranged through the organizers' contact information.

name: Hlbocký boyard – extrémny beh s prekážkami
description: Hlbocký Boyard is an extreme individual race taking place on May 23, 2026, in the village of Hlboké nad Váhom. This is the 6th edition offering a single course with numerous adrenaline-pumping obstacles and steep hills on a motocross track. Competitors will race in nine categories based on age and gender, including children's categories. Participants will enjoy fresh air, challenges on the course, and after the race, they will receive awards, refreshments, and commemorative items.
course_highlights: Course length of 9 - 10 km with many new obstacles compared to previous editions
Steep hills and adrenaline obstacles on a motocross track
Drinking water at the start and along the course, refreshments and goulash after the race
additional: Registration for competitors begins at 07:45 AM at the area near the football field. The start is staggered, with the first start for the children's Boyard, followed by starts every 5 minutes with 4-5 competitors each. The registration fee includes a medal, a commemorative item, a ticket for goulash and a drink, a sweet treat, water, and refreshments on the course. Showers with hot water are available in the football cabins after the race. Spectators have free access to the entire course. Parking is free. The race takes place regardless of weather conditions. Registration can be done in advance with payment. The registration includes medals and refreshments. The registration period runs from March to May 2025.

name: Jacovská dvadsiatka
description: Jacovská dvadsiatka is a running race organized in Jacovce at the football stadium. The race offers two courses - a main 22 km and a hobby run of 8 km, which run on asphalt and field roads with gravel. The start is scheduled for 10:00 for the 22 km and 10:15 for the 8 km. The race is suitable for various age categories and genders, organized by ATK Javorina Jacovce. The entry fee is available at affordable prices, making the event accessible to a wide running community.
course_highlights: 50% asphalt roads and 50% field roads with gravel
Two courses: 22 km and 8 km
Start at the football stadium in Jacovce
additional: Categories for the 22 km are divided by age: up to 39 years, from 40 to 49 years, 50 years and above; for the 8 km, categories are men and women. The start is divided into two waves: 10:00 for 22 km and 10:15 for 8 km. 50% asphalt and 50% field roads, registration available via email, sale or exchange of starting numbers, the race takes place on May 23, 2026.

name: Kostolanský májovec
description: Kostolanský májovec is a running event organized by run ForRest run o.z., held at the Michal Podolan football stadium in Veľké Kostoľany. Participants can choose between two courses measuring 10.90 km and 5.40 km, both with an elevation gain of 64 meters and a surface combining asphalt and meadow. The start is scheduled for 11:00 AM, and competitors are divided into age categories with awards for the fastest Kostolanec and Kostolanka. The event offers refreshments and is suitable for runners seeking a pleasant run with slight elevation in a beautiful environment.
course_highlights: Course 10.90 km with elevation gain +64 m
Course 5.40 km with elevation gain +64 m
Surface 50% asphalt and 50% meadow
additional: The race results will be announced at 12:45 PM. To be classified in categories, the year of birth is decisive. For the fastest Kostolancov/Kostolanky, it is necessary to specify the municipality Veľké Kostoľany during registration. Number of refreshment stations on the course: 1. The race is conducted according to traffic rules. Participants are responsible for their own health insurance. The course is mostly flat, registration is possible online and on-site, the event includes categories for various age groups, and it is suitable for both recreational and competitive runners.

name: Sninský trailový polmaratón
description: Sninský trailový polmaratón is a running event in Snina, Slovakia, offering two courses - a main 21 km course and a shorter 7.5 km course. The race is designed for all trail running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of nature and the challenge of terrain. Organizers welcome runners of all levels and provide a quality sports event atmosphere.
course_highlights: Trail running in the natural environment of Snina
Two course options: 21 km and 7.5 km
Challenge for runners of all levels
additional: The race is suitable for runners of all levels, with the option to register online or on-site, and includes various categories including children and youth.

name: Beh Soviou Poľanou
description: The Soviou Poľanou Run in Podolínec is a forest running race that offers quality training and an opportunity to test your abilities in mountain terrain. The race is suitable for runners who want to experience an exhilarating day in nature and prepare for important races in the season. The course runs through picturesque forests around Podolínec and provides a challenge even for experienced runners.
course_highlights: Forest courses around Podolínec
Mountain terrain with natural obstacles
Scenic views in the Poľana area
additional: Children's runs and multiple course options including 11 km and 18 km variants are available. Maps, posters, and regulations can be downloaded. Registration is conducted online via the official website. The race is part of a series with the possibility of online registration and various categories, including a children's run. The event aims to promote trail running in nature and offers attractive prizes for the best in each category.

name: Turčiansky beh
description: Turčiansky Run is a charity running race held on May 23, 2026, at the football stadium in Belá - Dulice. Runners can choose between a 5 km or 10 km route, which runs through slightly hilly terrain along a country road and gravel path with an elevation gain of 40 to 80 meters. The event supports a good cause, as all proceeds will go towards the treatment of a 4-year-old boy with autism and the project "Children of My Heart." Participants will receive gifts, raffle tickets, commemorative medals, and entertainment for children, while parents can run and children are cared for. Refreshments and parking are available at the start and finish areas.
course_highlights: Route runs along a country road and gravel path
Elevation gain of 40 to 80 meters, slightly hilly
Start and finish at Belá Dulice football stadium
additional: Registration takes place on the day of the race from 8:00 to 11:00. Before the start, each participant receives a drink, a protein bar, and a gift from partners. The entry fee includes one raffle ticket with the option to purchase additional tickets. After finishing, each runner receives a commemorative medal. There are entertainment activities with professional animators and attractions for children. Parking is available near the start/finish area. Refreshments and drinks can be purchased on site. Virtual participants will receive a gift and medal sent to their address after the event. The terrain includes country roads and asphalt; parking is available at the start/finish, and changing rooms, showers, and refreshments are available on site. Registration is possible online, with options for virtual participation.

name: Mravenčárska míľa
description: The Ant Hill Mile is a running event held at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok. The race offers categories for various age groups of men and women, as well as for children, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The start for youth is at 10:10 AM and for the main category at 12:00 PM. The organizer is the Municipal Office of Plavecký Štvrtok, which ensures a pleasant atmosphere and quality organization for all participants.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok
Multiple age and special categories including Nordic walking and canicross
Main categories start at 12:00 PM, youth start at 10:10 AM
additional: Categories include men and women in various age groups, children, youth, juniors, Nordic walking, and canicross. The organizers are Milan Zajíček and Soňa Zajíčková with contact phone numbers 0907 467 595 and 0908 423 975. The race offers categories for different age groups, including children, Nordic walking, and canicross; starts are scheduled for 10:10 AM and 12:00 PM; the event takes place at the football stadium in Plavecký Štvrtok.

name: Niže Linča
organizer: Dobrovoľníci z obce Zeleneč, Obecný úrad Zeleneč, Vinársky spolok vinárov a vinohradníkov Zeleneč, DHZ Zeleneč, Zdravotnícka služba Zeleneč

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné: 15 € do 15.05.2026 ( online registrácia bude spustená od 13.4. 2026 )

description: Niže Linča is a running event in Zeleneč organized by volunteers from the community along with local associations and healthcare services. The race is open to men, women, and juniors under 18 years old, with competitions also for the fastest man and woman. The entry fee includes access to a wine tasting during the SvätoUrbanských festivities, adding a unique atmosphere to the event and combining sport with culture. Online registration will open on April 13, 2026, and the race will take place on May 23, 2026.
course_highlights: Race in Zeleneč, Vinohrady Zeleneč
Categories for men, women, and juniors under 18
Wine tasting included in the registration fee
additional: The registration fee includes access to a wine tasting during the SvätoUrbanských festivities valued at €5. Online registration from April 13, 2026. Location: Zeleneč, district rnava. Start time: 18:30. Venue: Jednotka.

name: Martinský offroad maratón a polmaratón
description: The Martinský off-road marathon and half marathon is a running event held in the beautiful nature of the Fatra region, in the locality of Tomčany near Martin. Participants can enjoy running across meadows, hills, and the outskirts of the Fatra with stunning views of Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra. The route is of off-road character, with natural obstacles such as mud and fallen trees, which adds to the attractiveness and challenge for runners. The event is designed for various groups of runners, who can choose their trail according to their abilities and preferences.
course_highlights: Running races through Fatra's natural landscape, across meadows and hills
Beautiful views of Lúčanská, Krivánska, and Veľká Fatra
Off-road route with natural obstacles like mud and fallen trees
additional: Mandatory equipment: a cup or bottle of at least 0.2 liters, a phone with the organizer's number (0949 465 006). Location: Tomčany (a borough of Martin). The event is in its 1st edition. No specific prices or registration dates are provided on the website. Course lengths range from 4.5 km to a marathon, registration via MisoSport.sk, mandatory equipment includes a cup or bottle and a phone with the organizer's number, various routes and activities for children, start at 10:00.

name: AZ-Pneu Vertical – Dúbravský beh na Kobylu
location: Ul. Pod záhradami, Mestská časť Dúbravka, Bratislava, Slovakia

price_tiers.distance: AZ-pneu vertical 10 km a Dôverun 5 km

description: AZ-Pneu Vertical - Dúbravský run on Kobylu is a running event in Bratislava that offers routes for both children and adults. The race takes place in the city district of Dúbravka, starting near Pod záhradami street (by Lidl). You can compete on the 10 km AZ-pneu vertical course, the 5 km Dôverun, or in children's runs. The organizer is Beh si ty, o.z., together with the Dúbravka Municipal District. The race is suitable for the general public and offers categories based on age and gender.
course_highlights: Start and finish in the Dúbravka district of Bratislava
The AZ-pneu vertical course is 10 km long
In addition to the main course, there are children's runs and a 5 km Dôverun
additional: ZP Dôvera policyholders receive a 2 Euro discount when paying the start fee online. The children's runs start at 10:20, the main AZ-pneu vertical 10 km run starts at 11:00, and the Dôverun 5 km at 11:20. The course runs through city streets in Dúbravka. Registration is possible online and on-site. The event is scheduled for May 23, 2026.

name: Beh s vlkmi pre život
price_range: od 11 € do 40 € v závislosti od spôsobu registrácie
description: Run with Wolves for Life is a charity running event organized by the CHADIM'S CHARITY Foundation, taking place in the picturesque environment of Čierne at the Tripoint of Slovakia, Czech Republic, and Poland. It offers six different routes including a half marathon, 10K run, 5K run, Nordic walking, and children's races, with courses mainly on asphalt and forest roads featuring beautiful mountain views. Participants can expect quality organization with marked trails, refreshment stations, and an escort vehicle with water. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes a healthy lifestyle and charitable goals.
course_highlights: Half marathon with an elevation gain of +500 m, running along mountain ridges with beautiful views
Routes mainly on asphalt and forest roads
Marked trails with flags and volunteers at key intersections
additional: The half marathon has a time limit of 5 hours, and the 10 km run 2 hours. Participants must wear bib numbers on the front and pass all control points. There is one refreshment station on the course, with water available at the start and finish. During the race, an escort vehicle will distribute water at accessible locations. Mandatory equipment includes personal identification documents, and insurance with coverage for medical expenses is recommended due to crossing through multiple countries. The event includes various categories for adults and children, on-site registration, accompanying program, and refreshments, emphasizing support for charitable activities.

name: Hutňanská šelma
description: Hutňanská šelma is a running event in Novoveská Huta that offers starts for both children and adults. The race takes place in the pleasant environment of the Craftsman's Inn behind Holubnica and is divided into several age categories with awards for the top three finishers. The start for children's categories is at 10:00 AM, and for adults and older children at 1:00 PM. The event is suitable for runners of various age groups and skill levels.
course_highlights: Race in the environment of Novoveská Huta, Craftsman's Inn behind Holubnica
Multiple age categories from children to adults
Start for children at 10:00 AM, for adults and older children at 1:00 PM
additional: The race categories include children up to 6 years old, children from 7-9 years old, children from 10-14 years old, youth, and adults divided by age with awards for the top three in each category. The race takes place in the beautiful environment of Novoveská Huta, with the start for children at 10:00 AM and for adults at 1:00 PM. Participants receive a medal, and there are various attractions during the event.

name: VeganRun
description: VeganRun Slovakia is the first official Slovak vegan run organized by the Slovak Vegan Society. The event combines sport, health, and compassion, offering more than just a run – it is a collective step towards a healthier body, a cleaner planet, and an informed society. The routes lead from the iconic Amphitheatre in Rača through the interface of the Carpathian forest and vineyards, providing forest therapy, diverse terrain, and epic views of Bratislava. Participants can choose between 5 km, 10 km, and Canicross disciplines, which allow running with a dog.
course_highlights: Routes pass through the Carpathian forest and blooming vineyards with fresh air and shade of trees
Panoramic views of Bratislava from vineyard paths
Diverse terrain from soft forest trails to winding paths in the Little Carpathians
additional: Timing is available on all routes. The option to run with a dog in the Canicross discipline. The routes are suitable for beginners and advanced runners. The proceeds from the event support animals in shelters and an educational program on plant-based nutrition for doctors. The event is charitable and supports educational programs on plant-based nutrition, with proceeds donated to animal shelters and medical education.

name: Bytčiansky Kros
organizer: Behači Bytča a okolie, v spolupráci s Mesto Bytča
description: Bytčiansky Cross is a traditional running race in Bytča, offering four courses of varying lengths and difficulty levels, including the Super Cross with a length of 21 km and an elevation gain of 500 m. The course mainly runs through terrain such as dirt roads, meadows, and cycle paths, with 80% off-road surface and 20% paved surface. Participants can expect three refreshment stations on the longer routes and thorough course marking. The competitions are divided by age categories for both men and women, with the top three in each category being awarded.
course_highlights: Super Cross 21 km with an elevation gain of +500 m
Course runs 80% through terrain and 20% on paved surfaces
Three refreshment stations on longer routes
additional: Participants on the Super Cross 21 km course must have downloaded the GPS file of the course map to their phone or watch and carry a charged and functional mobile phone. The course is marked with ribbons, arrows, and volunteers. The route has changed compared to previous editions due to the cycle path, running on the left side of the Váh Canal. Registration includes the mandatory download of the GPS file and readiness on the mobile phone; the race takes place on various terrains including asphalt, dirt roads, and cycle paths.

name: Beh v Raji – prológ
description: The Run in Paradise is a traditional running race held in the beautiful surroundings of Dobšinská Ice Cave and its vicinity. Participants can choose from several courses including a prologue, half marathon, 10 km, and 5 km routes, which mainly run on asphalt roads with partial traffic closure. The prologue is a hilly 1 km run through a forest trail from the parking lot to the ice cave. The event is suitable for the general public and also offers Nordic walking.
course_highlights: Prologue 1 km hilly course through a forest trail to the ice cave
Half marathon route runs on an asphalt road through the village of Stratená and Stratenská Píla
10 km and 5 km routes are flat and run on asphalt roads with partial traffic closure
additional: Registration for participants is at the OOCR building. The prologue starts on Friday, May 29, 2026 from 16:00 to 17:15, with Saturday's races on May 30, 2026 from 8:00 to 10:40. Participants will receive a headband made of functional material with the Run in Paradise logo (first 300 registered) and refreshments after crossing the finish line. The races are held with partial road closure, with one lane reserved for runners. The race time limit is 2 hours and 30 minutes. The event includes categories for men and women, with a start at 17:30. Registration is possible on the website. The race is supported by the Košice Region.

name: Ružindolský víchor

price_tiers.distance: Beh 7 km a Nordic Walking 4 km

description: The Ružindolský Víchor Run is the 12th edition of a road race held at the sports complex in Ružindol. The course runs on asphalt and dirt surfaces in the village and includes a grass track at the stadium. Participants can choose between a 7 km run and a 4 km Nordic Walking. The start is scheduled for 17:30, with categories for men, women, local runners, and Nordic Walking. Participants will receive a start number, a timing chip, refreshments, and a finisher's medal.
course_highlights: Course with asphalt and dirt surfaces in the village
Grass track at the stadium
Two disciplines: 7 km run and 4 km Nordic Walking
additional: The start package includes a start number, a timing chip (which is returned at the finish line after the race), refreshments along the course and at the finish, and a participant medal. Changing rooms are available at the Ružindol sports complex. Categories are divided by age and gender, including categories for local runners from Ružindol. The course is a combination of asphalt, dirt, and grass track; the race is open to men, women, locals, and Nordic Walking enthusiasts. Registration is possible online or on-site. Refreshments and medals for winners are provided.

name: Salibský polmaratón, Hornosalibská desiatka, Hornosalibská trojka
location: Areál futbalového ihriska TJ Horné Saliby, Horné Saliby, Slovakia
organizer: Obce Horné Saliby a Dolné Saliby
price_range: 13,-€ online do 31.3.2025, 16,-€ online do 28.5.2025, 10,- € pre seniorov nad 60 rokov, deti a nad 60 rokov štartovné neplatia
description: Salibský half marathon, Hornosalibská ten and Hornosalibská triple are traditional running events organized by RoniRun Club in the village of Horné Saliby. The races offer certified courses with distances of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 3 km, passing through a scenic area with refreshments and chip timing. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, for whom special children's runs are prepared. In addition to the sporting experience, visitors can look forward to a rich accompanying program with music, martial arts demonstrations, and a raffle.
course_highlights: Certified courses of 21.1 km, 10 km, and 3 km
Refreshment stations with non-alcoholic Zlatý Bažant beer and a wide selection of drinks
Scenic environment of Horné Saliby with a football field area of TJ Horné Saliby
additional: The start package includes a race number, refreshments during and after the race, chip timing, non-alcoholic Zlatý Bažant beer, a ticket for the raffle, and a event plastic cup. The races are eco-friendly with paper and returnable cups with a 2€ deposit. Children's runs are free, and children will receive medals. During the event, a rich accompanying program is prepared, including inflatable castles, horses, horse-drawn carriages, drummers, a DJ, martial arts demonstrations, and archery. The event features courses of 21 km, 10 km, and 3 km, with starts scheduled at 10:00, 10:30, and 10:35, and a children's run at 9:15. There is also a charitable aspect and eco-friendly cups.

name: Self-Transcendence 6/12h a 100km beh / Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 100km beh
description: Sri Chinmoy Self-Transcendence 6/12-hour and 100 km race in Šamorín is a traditional ultramarathon event taking place on May 30, 2026, in Mestský park Pomlé. It is the 24th edition of the 6-hour race and the 15th edition of the 12-hour and 100 km race, offering categories for individuals and relay teams. Runners can compete in various age groups, including veterans over 50 years old. Relay teams consist of up to three runners, who can alternate in any order, with each member required to complete at least one lap after passing the baton. Performance is measured by the actual distance run, with accuracy to the meter.
course_highlights: The race takes place in Mestský park Pomlé in Šamorín
The course is a loop where runners can switch in relays at a specially designated section
The time limit for the 100 km race is 12 hours
additional: Runners can take breaks at any time, but must notify the lap recorder. After finishing, it is necessary to place a marker on the left side of the track and remain nearby until the actual distance run is recorded. For safety reasons, it is not allowed to accompany runners on bicycles or skates. The course medical officer has the right to disqualify any participant at any time. The event includes categories for 6h, 12h, and 100km, with relay options, and has established rules for distance measurement and conduct during the race. Registration is open with specified dates and fees.

name: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom
location: Športový areál, Veľké Lovce, Nové Zámky, Slovakia
description: Hore Lótom Dole Lótom is the fourth edition of a running event scheduled for May 30, 2026, at the sports complex in Veľké Lovce. The race courses run through the streets and outskirts of the village on asphalt and field roads. The event also features children's categories with various distances based on age, as well as main races of 5 km and 10 km. The event is suitable for the general public and offers awards in categories by age and gender. Organizers emphasize convenient online registration and high-quality chip timing.
course_highlights: The course runs through the streets and outskirts of Veľké Lovce
Surface of the course is asphalt and field road
Children's categories with distances from 40 m to 1000 m
additional: The participant limit for the 5 km and 10 km runs is 250. School rounds have a limit of 160 participants. Registered runners will receive participation medals. On-site registration is possible from 14:00 on race day if the limit is not reached. Timing is secured with chips, except for preschoolers. It is recommended to register with diacritics and create an account on the website for easier modifications to the registration. Trails include asphalt and dirt roads; registration online and on-site; medals for all finishers; optional T-shirts; health information on race bibs.

name: Memoriál Jozefa Gabčíka
organizer: Žilinský pluk Jozefa Gabčíka, Klub vojenských výsadkárov Slovenskej republiky, Železničná spoločnosť Slovensko, Ministerstvo obrany SR

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 23 € – pri registrácii cez online na www.gabcikrun.sk

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Účasť v detských behoch je bezplatná. Štartovné sa neplatí.

description: The Jozef Gabčík Memorial is an annual running event held in honor of the paratrooper and hero Jozef Gabčík, a prominent figure in the anti-fascist resistance. This 11 km cross run on mixed terrain starts from Žilina - Poluvsie, the birthplace of Jozef Gabčík, and ends at the sports complex of the 5th Special Forces Regiment in Žilina. The event brings together civilian and military runners and promotes physical performance and community spirit. The registration fee includes a race kit, refreshments, a commemorative medal, and timing with a chip.
course_highlights: 11 km cross run on mixed terrain
Start at the birthplace of Jozef Gabčík in Poluvsie
Finish at the sports complex of the 5th Special Forces Regiment in Žilina
additional: The event has a capacity of 500 runners. Registration is valid only after the payment is credited by April 1, 2026; otherwise, it will be canceled. The registration fee covers administrative costs, a race kit, refreshments, prizes for winners, a commemorative medal, and timing with a chip from HRDOSPORT, including online results. Children's categories are free of charge; registration is available online and on-site before the start. The race takes place in Žilina - Poluvsie. Registration is possible online and on-site; the registration fee includes a start number with a chip, refreshments, prizes, a medal, and timing.

name: Kurimské pobehaňe
description: Kurima Run is a running event organized by o.z. Aktívna Kurima, held in the village of Kurima in front of the manor house. The course runs on asphalt and rural roads with surfaces of dirt and gravel. The race is open to various age categories from schoolchildren to veterans, with both men and women competing in different age groups. Registration is available online with different fee levels depending on the registration date, and a school run for children is also organized. The event is suitable for runners seeking a pleasant and community-oriented running experience in nature.
course_highlights: Surface of the course: asphalt and rural roads with dirt and gravel
Start location: in front of the manor house in Kurima, Bardejov district
Multiple age categories including school run
additional: Categories include elementary school pupils, juniors up to 17 years old, men and women in various age groups. The organizer is o.z. Aktívna Kurima. Contact for the organizer: Ing. Tomáš Bolišinga, phone: 0910 902 784. The race takes place in Kurima near the manor house, with online registration or on-site registration, with details on dates and fees available on the official website.

description: MEA GRATI Ultramarathon of Gratitude 2026 is a charitable ultramarathon that takes runners along a 64 km route from Košice to Tokaj. This run is not only about physical performance but also about demonstrating humanity and supporting homeless people through the organization Oasis. Each kilometer symbolizes a journey back to human dignity and participation generates funds to improve the lives of people in need. Runners can enjoy top-notch organization, a global atmosphere, and wine as a reward for their effort.
course_highlights: 64 km route from Košice to Tokaj
Charitable run supporting homeless people
Symbolic significance of each kilometer as a journey to human dignity
additional: Participation in the ultramarathon includes top-notch organization, and after the run, a global atmosphere and wine are prepared as a reward. The run through Tokaj, registration via the official website, route from Košice to Tokaj, takes place on May 30, 2026.

name: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso

description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run in the beautiful environment of the High Tatras, taking place for the 14th time. Runners can choose between a 5 km and a 10 km course leading around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso, the Lakes of Love, and through the Snow cross-country ski area. The event is part of the Grand Prix series and offers a unique atmosphere with views of Rysy and running into the night. In addition to the adult races, children's runs and Nordic walking are also organized. Telekom Night Run is a popular annual stop for runners who enjoy beautiful running experiences in the mountain environment.
course_highlights: Course runs around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso and the Lakes of Love
Night run with finishing in darkness and views of Rysy
Passage through the Snow cross-country ski area
additional: Start and finish at the main road between the FIS hotel and the Patria hotel. The time limit for the run is 1.5 hours. The participant limit is 1000 runners with properly paid entry fee. The event also includes children's runs (300 m, 600 m, 800 m) and 5 km Nordic walking. Registration is possible online until 29.05.2026 or in person on the day of the race from 12:00 to 18:00 at Štrbské Pleso, if the limit is not reached. The event is part of the Grand Prix 2026 series, allows online and in-person registration, has a limited number of participants (1000), and includes various categories such as charity run, children's races, and Nordic walking.

name: Turbo TV detské behy Štrbské Pleso
location: Main road between Hotel FIS and Hotel Patria, Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Slovakia
description: Telekom Night Run Štrbské Pleso is a traditional night run set in the beautiful environment of the High Tatras, taking place for the 14th time. Runners can choose between a 5 km and a 10 km course leading around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso with stunning views of the Tatra peaks. The event also features Turbo TV children's runs with various distances for the youngest to teenagers, offering unforgettable experiences and medals. The atmosphere of the event is exceptional, with encouragement along the course and finishing in the dark, making this run a popular stop for runners during the season.
course_highlights: The course runs around Malé and Veľké Štrbské Pleso with beautiful views of Rysy
Refreshment station on the 10 km course and encouragement along the route
Night run finishing in the dark with a unique atmosphere of the High Tatras
additional: Children's Turbo TV runs have distances of 300 m, 600 m, and 800 m with medals for participation. Nordic walking 5 km is also part of the event. #REŠPEKT run is a non-competitive discipline with voluntary entry fee, with proceeds donated to children's oncology. The time limit for the main courses is 1.5 hours. The participant limit is 1000 runners with properly paid entry fee. Registration is possible online until 29.05.2026 or in person on the day of the race from 12:00 to 18:00 at Štrbské Pleso, if the limit is not reached. Course lengths range from 300 to 800 meters, categories by age, start on the main road between Hotel FIS and Hotel Patria, registration during presentation, refreshments, and a medal are included in the entry fee.

description: Fatranský Vĺčko is a canine endurance sport that combines hiking and running with a dog in the beautiful nature of Veľká Fatra. The event will take place on May 30, 2026, in Turčiansky Jaseno and offers two routes - the longer MID with a length of 44 km and an elevation gain of +2350 m, and the shorter SHORT with a length of 14 km and an elevation gain of +500 m. Participants can compete in the dogtrekking category (person with dog) or trail (running without dog). Throughout the entire route, the dog must be on a leash or harness; free movement of dogs results in disqualification. Organizers recommend the MID route for experienced participants and the SHORT route for beginners or less trained.
course_highlights: Route MID: 44 km with an elevation gain of +2350 m on marked hiking trails and own markings
Route SHORT: 14 km with an elevation gain of +500 m on marked hiking trails and own markings
Beautiful nature of Veľká Fatra with additional markings (flags) and current route information
additional: The registration fee includes a start number, timing via code, participation package with sponsor gifts, refreshments along the route, and a drink at the finish line. There is an option to purchase food at the finish (meat or vegetarian) for 6 EUR. Participants under 15 years old must be accompanied by an adult, and those aged 15 to 18 require written consent from a legal guardian. The number of participants is limited. Registration is conducted via an external link, with rules including mandatory dog leashes and safety measures. The event takes place in the Ovčín - Boulder & Bistro area in Turiec.

name: Beh Rajeckým rínkom
description: The Rajecký Rínok Run is a traditional running race organized by the Rajec Marathon Club, held at SNP Square in Rajec. The race offers runners the opportunity to experience the beauty of nature and the surroundings of Rajec during the day in May. The event is suitable for the general public, including children and minors, who must have the consent of a legal guardian. Organizers emphasize safety and quality preparation for participants.
course_highlights: The route runs through the picturesque Rajecký Rínok
Start and finish at SNP Square in Rajec
Natural environment with gentle elevation
additional: Participants under 18 must bring a signed declaration from a legal guardian. Personal data of participants are processed in accordance with applicable personal data protection legislation. The event takes place in Rajec, with registration fees starting from €3 for early registrations. It is suitable for all age groups, including children, and is part of the sports day in the town.

name: Beh na Zniev
description: Zniev Run is a mountain race held in Kláštor pod Znievom, offering a challenging course of 5,650 meters with an elevation gain of 475 meters. The race is open to a wide range of categories from children to veterans, including men, women, juniors, and youth. The main race starts at 14:00 in the area of the former gymnasium. The organizers are the Municipal Office of Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT, and the Slovak Athletic Federation, and the race is part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup.
course_highlights: Course length of 5,650 meters with an elevation gain of 475 meters
Course runs around Kláštor pod Znievom, district of Martin
Part of the Slovak Mountain Running Cup
additional: The start of children's categories is at 14:30, youth categories at 15:00. Categories are divided by age and gender, including several age groups from the youngest pupils to veterans. The organizers are the Municipal Office of Kláštor pod Znievom, Strive sport, TRIMAT, and the Slovak Athletic Federation. The race is part of the Slovak championships in mountain running, suitable for both professional and recreational runners, with online registration available or on-site registration.

name: Pivovarsko-hradná sedemtisícovka
location: areál TJ Slavoj V. Šariš, Veľký Šariš, Prešov, Slovakia
description: The Pivovarsko-hradná Seven Thousand Race is a running event organized by the town of Veľký Šariš in cooperation with the Šariš Brewery and the Sports Committee of the Municipal Council in Veľký Šariš. The race takes place at the TJ Slavoj Veľký Šariš sports complex and offers categories for various age groups and Nordic walking. The start is scheduled for 15:00 for running and 15:05 for Nordic walking. The event is suitable for the general public, including youth, juniors, women, and men of different age categories.
course_highlights: The 7000-meter course runs through the picturesque surroundings of Veľký Šariš
Participants can compete in various categories including juniors, adults, and Nordic walking
The event is part of the local sports tradition and is organized by the town in cooperation with the local brewery
additional: Categories include youth, junior women, women, and men in various age groups. The Nordic walking start is 5 minutes later than the running race.
