Šariš sports complex, registration is also possible on-site, and the event is open to the general public, including Nordic walking participants.

name: Banskobystrický maratón
location: Námestie pred Europa SC, Banská Bystrica, Slovakia
price_range: 33 € to 108 € v závislosti od kategórie a termínu registrácie
description: The Banská Bystrica Marathon is the largest periodic sports event in central Slovakia, offering a magical evening atmosphere and a fast, experiential certified course. Participants can choose from several disciplines including the marathon, half marathon, 10K run, 5K STEFE run, and relay races. The course is well secured with refreshment stations and sound systems, ensuring a quality experience for all participants. The event is suitable for active runners and families who want to enjoy movement and a sporting atmosphere.
course_highlights: Magical evening course with certification
Half marathon consists of 3 fast laps with 12 refreshment stations
Super-fast 10K with minimal elevation
additional: The half marathon has 12 refreshment stations and the entire course is sound-equipped. The relay race consists of 3 segments of 7 km each. The STEFE five-kilometer run is designed for families and active runners. The event takes place on June 6, 2026, starting at the Square in front of Europa SC, with several aid stations and various categories for all age groups.

name: Poludnica Run
description: Poludnica Run is a mountain race in the Low Tatras with a course length of 23 km and an elevation gain of 1600 meters. The route mainly follows marked hiking trails, through beautiful south-facing single tracks in the forest, a rock city, and the Poludnica peak with panoramic views of Liptov and the Tatras. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning League and the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia, serving as a qualifying race for the World Skyrunning Championships. The atmosphere is friendly, and the course is considered one of the most challenging in Slovakia within its category. The last edition of this event will take place in 2026.
course_highlights: 23 km long course with an elevation gain of 1600 m
Route follows marked hiking trails, single tracks, and a rock city
Poludnica peak with panoramic views of Liptov, Western and High Tatras
additional: Registration opens on March 23, 2026. Check-in and pickup of race bibs are on race day from 07:00 to 08:40 at the start area. The mass start is at 09:00. The maximum number of participants is 200. There is a refreshment station at 19 km. The course is considered one of the most difficult in Slovakia within its category. After the results are announced at 14:00, a raffle will take place with tickets costing 2 €. The event is part of the seasonal ranking and ITRA point collection, with the possibility to earn points for the World Championships. The event also includes a raffle, a hot meal, and free parking.

name: Beh Vyšnou Myšľou
location: Futbalové ihrisko, Vyšná Myšľa, Košice, Slovakia
description: Vyšná Myšľa Running Race is a running event organized by the Vyšná Myšľa Running Club and the municipality of Vyšná Myšľa. The race takes place on the football field in Vyšná Myšľa and offers categories for various age groups of men, women, and children. It also includes a relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km. The children's categories start at 14:00 and the adults at 16:00. The event is suitable for the general public, including club members and residents of the municipality, who benefit from a reduced entry fee.
course_highlights: The race takes place on the football field in Vyšná Myšľa
Categories for men, women, and children by age
Relay race for pairs over 2 x 3 km
additional: Children start at 14:00, adults at 16:00. Entry fees are waived for Men E, Women I, members of BKO Vyšná Myšľa, residents of Vyšná Myšľa, and children. The event includes categories for children, adults, and relays, with the possibility of online registration as well as on-site registration. The course is situated on the football field and in the surrounding area of the village.

name: Trail Run
description: Trail Run in Družstevná pri Hornáde is a running competition offering a course with a natural character and diverse surfaces. The race takes place on June 6, 2026, with options to choose between 8 km and 15 km loops, which pass through asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads with an elevation gain of up to 309 meters. The event also includes children's categories with various distances, making it suitable for a wide age range of runners. The start and finish are located at the multifunctional playground on Okružná Street in Družstevná pri Hornáde.
course_highlights: 8 km loop with an elevation gain of 162 m
15 km loop with an elevation gain of 309 m
Course surface includes asphalt, concrete, forest, and field roads
additional: Registration is only possible online with payment via bank transfer or card, or payment on-site during registration. The program also includes children's categories with various distances and Nordic walking at 16:00. Registration begins at 13:30 and ends at 15:30, with children registering until 14:30. The event is supported by the e.SK foundation and aims to promote trail running in Slovak nature. Details about the route and registration will be published later.

The main categories start at 16:30, and children's categories begin at 13:00. The organizers are the Hôrka Municipal Office and TJ Baník Hôrka, who welcome runners of all ages and levels.

Hobby category for 5 km without age restrictions
Races for children and pupils with their own start

description: Run for a good cause is a running event in the village of Pača, offering a course length of 4.4 km. The race is intended for a wide age range from younger to older runners, with categories for men and women. It is a community run that combines sport and a good cause, allowing participants to compete in various age groups. The event is part of the pretekaj.sk platform and offers simple online registration.
course_highlights: Course length of 4.4 km in the village of Pača
Simple loop with one circuit
Categories for men and women aged 15 and older
additional: Registration is conducted via the pretekaj.sk platform, where it is necessary to create an account to manage entries. Partner clubs may offer loyalty or membership cards for quick registration. The event includes categories for men, women, and children, with start times scheduled at 9:30 and 10:30. The course is mostly asphalt with sections on gravel roads.

name: Beh na vrchol Minčola

The organizers are the Lipany Municipality in cooperation with hikers and supporters of running to Minčol. The race is suitable for all who enjoy uphill running and want to test their strength in a beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: Course length of 7,300 meters with an elevation gain of 649 meters
Start in Lúčka above the municipal office in Lipany
Part of the Vychodniarska Mountain Running League 2025
additional: Categories for competitors from preschool (2017 and younger) to seniors, including categories for Nordic Walking. The organizer is the town of Lipany in cooperation with hikers and supporters of running to Minčol. The registration fee is increased on the day of the race. The race is part of the Vychodniarska Mountain Running League 2025. Terrain: mountain trail, registration online or on-site, part of the Vychodniarska Mountain Running League 2025.

The course leads through challenging terrain, registration is possible online and on-site, with the start and finish at Hostinec pod zámkom.

The event is organized by Majcher-Production s.r.o. and is suitable for the general public who want to stay active and contribute to charity.

The charitable nature of the event combines sport with community support

description: The Šamorín Running League (ŠBL) is a series of running races organized by the 3klub Šamorín, intended for the general public without age or performance limits. Participants are evaluated in categories: men, women, boys, and girls, with shorter distances for children. The league takes place throughout the year and includes the traditional Pomlé Run event. The registration fee covers race numbers, timing, refreshments, and league evaluation. The final round will feature an official overall league assessment with awards for the best runners.
course_highlights: Lesopark Pomlé in Šamorín as start and finish point
Various categories with shorter and longer distances (100 m to 5 km)
Running courses in natural surroundings with refreshments at the finish
additional: Children's categories start gradually from 10:00 (preschoolers 100 m, younger pupils 700 m, older pupils 700 m) and adults start at 10:30. Registration takes place from 9:00 until 30 minutes before the category start on the meadow in Lesopark Pomlé. WC and changing rooms are available at the Amphitheatre. The registration fee includes race numbers, timing, refreshments at the finish, and a raffle. Kindergarten children receive a medal after finishing but will not be scored. The event is part of a series running from March to October 2026, with various categories for all age groups, located at Lesopark Pomlé.

name: Šebešská pätnástka
location: Nevického chatu, Vyšná Šebastová, Prešov, Slovakia
price_range: 12,- € online pred 27.5.2025; 20,- € na mieste; 4 km zadarmo
description: The Šebešská Fifteen is a running race organized by the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club in cooperation with the Vyšná Šebastová municipal office and sports associations. The main course measures 15.5 km with a climb to Nevický Chata, complemented by a recreational 3 km route and children's disciplines for various age categories. The race takes place annually on the first Sunday of June with a morning start and a rich cultural and social program that attracts hundreds of visitors. The event is part of several running competitions and leagues, with organizers emphasizing the development of sport and building the reputation of the village. Šebešská Fifteen received the Running Diamond award in 2011 and 2012.
course_highlights: Main course 15.5 km with a climb to Nevický Chata
Recreational route 3 km suitable for the general public
Children's disciplines for preschoolers to juniors
additional: The race is accompanied by a rich cultural and social program, a raffle, and performances by musical groups. It is also part of regional running competitions and the Eastern Slovak Grand Prix of endurance (VVCV). Race director Ján Tomčo is an active runner and founder of the MTC Vyšná Šebastová club, bringing a spirit of fair play and competitiveness to the event. The course includes a climb to Nevický Chata, with children's disciplines and a vibrant cultural program, awards, and recognitions.

name: Angličák night run Pezinok
description: Angličák Night Run Pezinok is a night running race over 5 kilometers held at the Rozálka Health Area in Pezinok. Runners can enjoy a fast and dynamic run along a route passing through the Malokarpatská region with artificial lighting, creating a unique atmosphere. The event is open to everyone aged 15 and older and is divided into start corridors based on performance. Organizers emphasize safety, so the use of headphones is prohibited, and reflective elements or headlamps are recommended. Registration is available online and is tied to the runner's name, with pre-registration possible until June 9, 2026.
course_highlights: 5 km night run with artificial lighting
Route passes through Rozálka Health Area, Malokarpatská region, and Radničné námestie
Start corridors based on previous race times
additional: The minimum age of participants is 15 years as of the calendar year 2025. Pre-registration of a ticket for another person is possible until June 9, 2026, for a fee of 10 euros. The use of headphones during the run is strictly prohibited. Reflective elements and headlamps are recommended due to the night run. The start fee is non-transferable and tied to the participant's name. The route goes from Rozálka Health Area through Malokarpatská, Majakovského Bridge, Okružná Street, SNP Bridge, Kupeckého, Holubyho, and ends at Radničné námestie. Registration is only possible online, pre-registration is required, and the start fee is linked to the participant's name.

name: The Run Slovakia
description: THE RUN SLOVAKIA 2026 is a national relay race across Slovakia taking place over three days. Runners collectively cover more than 530 km from Košice to Bratislava, passing through beautiful natural scenery, historical landmarks, and picturesque towns. The event offers a unique sporting atmosphere, team cooperation, and many unforgettable experiences. The route passes through significant sites such as Spiš Castle, High Tatras, Orava Castle, and Little Carpathians, with participants also experiencing a rich accompanying program.
course_highlights: Route length of 530 km from Košice to Bratislava
Passage through important natural and historical landmarks such as Spiš Castle, High Tatras, Orava Castle
Total ascent of 7308 m and descent of 7376 m
additional: The total number of participating teams is limited to 100. Registration is conducted via a web application that allows real-time tracking of runners, current results, navigation, and notifications from the organizing team. The race is intended for team runners, with the possibility to view results in real time. Registration is open, various promotional items are available, and there is a mobile app for performance tracking.

name: Ultra Nízke Tatry
description: The Ultra Low Tatras is the first edition of a mountain running event that traverses the ridge of the Low Tatras from west to east. The course is 49.7 km long with an elevation gain of 2650 meters and follows marked tourist trails from Donovaly to Srdiečko. The event is part of the Slovak Skyrunning Association calendar and also serves as a Memorial for Milan Styka, a notable runner and mountaineer who tragically died in 2025. The start is scheduled for June 13, 2026, at 7:00 AM in Donovaly at the Donovaly Brewery.
course_highlights: 49.7 km long course with 2650 m elevation gain
Ridge of the Low Tatras from Donovaly to Srdiečko
The route follows red, green, and yellow tourist trails passing by M.R. Štefánik Chalet and Kosodrevina
additional: Registration is possible online from December 20, 2025, at 00:00 and also on-site at the Donovaly Brewery on June 13, 2026, from 16:00 to 21:00, and on the morning of the race from 6:00 to 6:45. The provisional cut-off time at Chopok after 37 km is 15:00 (8 hours after the start). The organizer reserves the right to change the route due to weather conditions and to set time limits. The course passes through mountain terrain, with information available about registration, the commemorative nature of the event, possible route changes due to weather, and time limits depending on conditions.

name: Strečnianska mašľa
description: Strečnianska Mašľa is a mountain ultramarathon and long-distance walk around Strečno, taking place on June 13, 2026. The race offers two routes - a challenging 50 km course with an elevation gain of approximately 2985 meters and a shorter 25 km course, suitable for runners with dogs. The routes run along marked hiking trails through both parts of Malá Fatra and through a section of the national park, with start and finish at the Radinové football pitch in Strečno. Organizers provide start packages, prizes for the best participants, and quality conditions for competitors.
course_highlights: 50 km route with an elevation gain of approximately 2985 m through Malá Fatra
Routes run along marked hiking trails and through the national park area
Start and finish at the Radinové football pitch in Strečno
additional: Participant limit: 300 for 50 km, 300 for 25 km, 50 for 25 km with a dog. Starting number and chip are assigned by the organizers. Mandatory equipment includes a first aid kit, valid ID, mountain rescue insurance, a charged mobile phone, a personal drinking container, a whistle or bells (recommended for the 50 km route), a map or GPS device, sunglasses, and sunscreen. Accommodation is available in changing rooms or tents at the football pitch. Lodging is also available at Pizzeria Alžbetka and SIP ŽSR Strečno. The race features certified routes, registration opens on March 1, 2026, and is part of the Slovak Ultratrail League. The course passes through the Malá Fatra national park.

name: Krosak pod hradom

Veľký krosák je 10 km (2 x 5 km okruh)
Pretek sa koná v malebnom prostredí Trnavy pri Laborci

name: Kysucký maratón
location: Čadca, Čadca, Matičné námestie - pred Domom kultúry Čadca, Slovakia

description: Kysucký marathon is the second oldest marathon in Slovakia and an important sports and social event in the Kysuce region. The course runs through the picturesque Kysuce valley along the Kysuca River, with a safer and more attractive route on a running cycle path from 2025. The event includes, besides the marathon, a half marathon, marathon relay, and a mini marathon for children. The start and finish are at Matičné Square in Čadca in front of the Cultural House. Runners compete in various age categories, and participants have access to refreshment stations and facilities including changing rooms and wellness services.

Safe and attractive route on a running cycle path (Bystrická cycle trail)
Marathon turnaround at the square near the Slovak Orloj in Stará Bystrica
additional: The start and finish of the race are at Matičné Square in Čadca in front of the Cultural House. There are 8 refreshment stations along the course. Refreshments are provided after the race. Participants have access to changing rooms, a swimming pool, and a sauna at the local swimming pool. The marathon time limit is 5 hours for 40 km; exceeding this time may affect placement in the results. The course is on certified routes, with refreshment stations on the course, changing rooms, a pool, sauna, and post-race refreshments. Online registration is open until June 1, 2026. Organizer insurance is not included.

The entry fee is available online at a discounted price, encouraging early registration.

The race takes place at the Hodkovce Castle grounds in Žehra
Categories for various age groups and non-competitive variants of running and Nordic walking

The course includes forest, rural paths, and asphalt sections.

The event offers routes for adults and children, with the course surface consisting of forest paths. This fourth edition of the race is an opportunity to experience community, movement, and joy, with the proceeds from the run donated to children in need. The organizers emphasize quality organization and support for charitable causes.
course_highlights: Forest paths in the Kalvária environment
Routes for adults and children
Beautiful varied course with nice weather
additional: Registration is only possible online via vysledkovyservis.sk. On-site registration on the day of the race will not be available. After paying the entry fee, the participant's name will appear in the list of registered participants and a confirmation will be sent via email. There is an option for a voluntary contribution during registration to support Hugovi and Simonke. The participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children. The event is governed by the rules of the Slovak Athletic Federation. Registration is only available online; the event has a charitable purpose; the participant limit is 500 adults and 250 children; races are scheduled for 10:00 for children and 12:15 for adults.

The race is divided into several categories based on age and gender, including children's categories and Nordic walking. The start for the main categories is at 5:00 PM, children's categories start at 5:10 PM. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant summer running atmosphere.

Online registration with low entry fee
Children's runs on the meadow are free

Children's runs on the meadow are free, online registration until June 12, 2026, additional €2 fee per bib, start at 5:00 PM and 5:10 PM.

name: Beh na chatu pri Zelenom plese – Memoriál K. Jakeša
location: Tatranský Mlyn pri Zelenom plese, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: The Run at Chata pri Zelenom plese is a mountain race designed for sports and nature enthusiasts, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes. The event has been held regularly since 2005 during the second weekend of June and commemorates Karel Jakeš, a prominent Czechoslovak mountaineer. The course leads through challenging mountain terrain with significant elevation gain, making the race a challenge for all participants. The goal is to connect various sports groups and offer them a unique experience in the beautiful environment of the High Tatras.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 7.7 km
Total ascent 651 m
Total descent 18 m
additional: The event is organized with financial support from the Ministry of Tourism and Sports of the Slovak Republic. The race unites athletes, runners, climbers, skiers, mountaineers, cyclists, and ski mountaineers into one sporting community. Registration for the 20th edition has closed. The race will take place in June 2026, with registration available on the official website. The course starts at the bus stop Biela voda and ends at Chata pri Zelenom plese, suitable for runners of all levels with a love for mountain challenges.

name: Račiansky kros – leto
location: Knižková dolina, Bratislava – Rača, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Račiansky kros SUMMER is a running event in Bratislava-Rača offering three courses of varying lengths and elevation gains. The main course is 16 km with an elevation gain of 503 meters, another course is 9.5 km with an elevation gain of 335 meters, and there are also children's runs. The courses mainly pass through forest terrain with asphalt sections and are well marked in three ways. The event is suitable for different age categories and offers awards for the best in each category. The start is in Knižkova Dolina and the time limit is 3 hours for the main course.
course_highlights: Course 16 km with an elevation gain of +503 m, time limit 3 hours
Course 9.5 km with an elevation gain of +335 m, time limit 2 hours
Surface: 80% forest, 20% asphalt, marked with pink ribbons, white arrows, and laminated arrows on trees
additional: The course is marked in three ways: pink ribbons with race print on trees, white chalk arrows on the ground, and laminated arrows on trees (blue, pink, orange). Refreshment stations: 2 on the 16 km course, 1 on the 9.5 km course. Mandatory equipment includes a bib number attached visibly to the chest. Results are announced shortly after crossing. The course is mainly forest with asphalt sections; registration is possible online or on-site; children's runs with medals and prizes are part of the event; it is part of the Račiansky kros series with multiple editions throughout the year.

name: Vranovská desiatka
location: Dom kultúry vo Vranove nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Slovakia

The race is organized by the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal House of Culture. Categories are divided by age and gender, with the top three runners from Vranov also being recognized. The start and finish are at the House of Culture in Vranov nad Topľou. The race is suitable for the general public, from recreational runners to competitors.
course_highlights: Courses of 10 km and 5 km in the town of Vranov nad Topľou
Categories by age and gender including recognition of the top Vranov runners
Start and finish at the House of Culture in Vranov nad Topľou
additional: The race categories are divided into 10 km (men and women by age groups) and 5 km (men and women without categories). The registration fee is €15 for online registration and €20 for on-site registration. Organizers are the Town of Vranov nad Topľou, the Municipal Sports Club, and the Municipal House of Culture. The contact person is Eva Fedorňáková at phone number 0917 127 502. The race offers categories for 10 km and 5 km, with start at the House of Culture. Registration is possible online or on-site.

name: Čeľovská sedmička
description: The Cheľovská Seven is a running event held in the village of Čeľovce, Trebišov district, in front of the Cultural House. The race is designed for various categories including men, women, families, and children, offering a summer walk and a competition for the youngest runners. The event is part of the Beh.sk running community and promotes an active lifestyle in a pleasant village environment.
course_highlights: The event takes place in front of the Cultural House in Čeľovce
The event is intended for various age groups and families
The date of the event is June 14, 2026
additional: The start location is in front of the Cultural House in Čeľovce. Categories include men, women, families, and children, including the youngest runners and a summer walk. The race is part of local activities and is suitable for all age groups, including children and families.

The registration fee is available at a discounted price for early registration, and it is also possible to register on the day of the race. The organizers welcome all runners and sports enthusiasts to this traditional event.
course_highlights: 15 km course in the picturesque nature of Mlynčeky
Part of OCR races including Barbarian and Spartan
Favorable registration fees, €10 for registration before 21.6.2024

Runners will experience a combination of mountain trails and natural scenery, making this event a unique experience.

Two course options: 24 km and 11 km
Challenging terrain with beautiful views
additional: Trail race with mountain terrain, dedicated to Barnabáš Uvegeš, taking place in June 2026.

name: Prešov Running Series 2. kolo
description: Prešov Running Series Round 2, known as Šariš Run, is a running event held on the banks of Rybníky in Veľký Šariš under the historic Šariš Castle. This location is a new addition to the series and has gained great popularity among runners. The event is full of sporting spirit, community, and love for nature, offering a rich accompanying program including musical performances, health stalls, a relaxation zone, and activities for children. The atmosphere is friendly and family-oriented, making running an unforgettable experience for all participants.

Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps around Dubník as possible, with a friendly and supportive atmosphere. Organizers and volunteers ensure the event runs without any fee, emphasizing the community and charitable aspect of the event.

Running pairs have 8 hours to complete as many laps as possible
Pleasant natural environment and community atmosphere

Children up to 14.99 years old register on-site for a symbolic entry fee of at least 5 €, and the first 100 children receive a start package. The first 170 registered and paid runners will receive a start package and a medal. During the run, hydration and healthy refreshments are provided. Runners must report each completed lap at the check-line station, where their lap will be recorded. The event concludes with the announcement of results around 6:00 PM. The event is organized to help young girl Simonka Zigová by the toRun Stará Tura running club. It is a charitable, community, and fundraising event with online registration available.

description: Doby vežu is an extreme obstacle course and trail race held in Brezno, Slovakia. Participants must tackle challenging obstacles and complete a route leading to the top of the second highest observation tower in Slovakia, which is 40 meters tall and offers beautiful views. The course mainly runs through forest paths, meadows, and streams with minimal asphalt, featuring steep ascents and descents. In addition to the sporting experience, there is a accompanying entertainment program full of fun for all age groups. The organizer is M.Š.K Jašterice Brezno o.z., with Marek Janoštiak as the race director.

Refreshments will be available on the course and at the finish line (fruit and drinks). Children can participate only with parental consent. Categories are divided by age and race type. name: Grobský Runfest

description: Grobský Runfest is a two-day sports festival in Chorvátsky Grob that brings together professional athletes and recreational enthusiasts of all ages. It offers running courses of various distances, children's races, cycling competitions, and a rich cultural and entertainment program including a food zone and musical performances. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle in a pleasant environment with diverse activities for all visitors.

12 km Race for the Municipality Cup with 30% asphalt and 70% terrain, mostly flat
Children's races and cycling competitions divided by age categories

On-site registration for the 12 km: Saturday 16:00 - 18:00, Sunday 10:00 - 11:15, results announcement on Sunday at 13:00. The course surface is mainly asphalt and terrain with a flat profile. The festival also includes a floorball tournament, football cup, cycling zone, food zone, and recovery zone. The program features musical performances and presentations by local organizations. The event includes multiple sports activities, concerts, children's zones, refreshment stations, a recovery area, and competitive events for all age groups.

name: Beh 2 míle Bratislava – 6. kolo
description: The 2-Mile Run Bratislava is a regular 2-mile race organized by the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team at the Kuchajda swimming complex in Bratislava. The race is open to a wide range of categories including children, juniors, women, men, and veterans. Registration takes place directly on-site from 9:30 AM, with the start at 10:00 AM. There is also a competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup, where runners are scored based on their performances and participation in individual rounds.
course_highlights: Distance of the course 2 miles (3.218 km), children approximately 200 m

Registration and check-in at the volleyball court
additional: Registration takes place directly on-site from 9:30 AM. The start is at 10:00 AM. Categories: children (13 years and younger), juniors, women, men, veterans (women and men). Competition for the Sri Chinmoy Marathon Team's Traveling Cup with scoring based on participation and performance. In case of equal points, the best time after adjustment with a coefficient and shoe size determines the winner. The race is held at Kuchajda, with on-site registration available at the volleyball court; categories include children, juniors, women, men, and veterans; the event is part of a series of 12 races in 2025.

name: Tvrďák – Bratislava
description: Tvrďák Bratislava is the largest obstacle race in Slovakia, held at the Divoká Voda area in Čunovo. Participants overcome more than 20 obstacles over a course approximately 5 km long, with options to compete in various modes including a non-competitive fitness mode or timed mode. After the race, participants can relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments, and watch strength competitions. The race is suitable for children aged 8 to 14 and offers a medal, photos, and videos from the race as souvenirs.

After the race, relax by the pool, enjoy refreshments, try water sports, and watch strength competitions from 14:00. Entry fee is non-refundable, with options to transfer registration to another person or to next year for a fee. The event also includes a children's race, team or individual starts, and after the race, water activities and entertainment for all age groups.

name: Behu ulicami mesta Veľký Krtíš

The event is known for its tradition and high-quality organization, with start and finish lines at the Main Square in Moldava nad Bodvou. It also features a mass run for health, allowing broad public participation.

Monetary prizes are awarded to the top three competitors in both men's and women's categories, while others receive medals. All competition categories are age-restricted, and participants can only register for the category corresponding to their age. The event includes multiple categories, online registration, and sponsor support.

The races offer several challenging courses with significant elevation gain, testing the endurance and strength of competitors from over 30 countries. The organizer is TJ Maratonstav Úpice under the patronage of the towns of Janské Lázně and Úpice. Registration is open until May 24, 2026, and participants can look forward to professional organization and sponsor support.

Up/Downhill race: 8.95 km with an elevation gain of 594 m

Start lists are updated 1-2 times a week. After registration and payment of the entry fee, a confirmation email will be sent. The race is intended for experienced runners with excellent physical condition and traverses the entire range, including Krivánska and Lúčanská Fatra. The event is a registered member of ITRA and serves as a qualifying race for other prestigious ultratrails. Organized by Slovak Ultra Trail in cooperation with volunteers and partners.
course_highlights: The route passes through the entire Malá Fatra mountain range (Krivánska and Lúčanská Fatra)
Significant ascents and descents with exposed sections
Available routes: MF100 (107 km / 7300 m+), MF50 (56 km / 4400 m+), MF33 (35 km / 2600 m+)
additional: A mandatory part of the equipment is insurance for intervention by the Mountain Rescue Service, which can be ordered directly during registration. A functional and cotton T-shirt with original print is available. Discounts on start fees are possible based on the ITRA Performance Index. Registration and start take place in Terchová. Trail race through Malá Fatra with significant ascents and descents, exposure, and mountain terrain; registration details not specified.

name: Svätojánsky beh na Domaši
description: The St. John's Run at Domaša is a traditional running race held at the recreational resort Domaša Dobrá. Participants can choose between two courses - a short 5 km and a long 13 km, which mainly run through forest roads and trails with varied elevation. The event is suitable for the general public, including categories by age and gender, with organizers providing refreshment stations, changing rooms, toilets, and medical services. The atmosphere is friendly and competitive, with valuable material prizes for the winners.
course_highlights: Long course 13 km with an elevation gain of approximately 356 m uphill and 314 m downhill
Short course 5 km running through forest road with an elevation gain of 70 m
Refreshment stations at 5 km, 10 km, and at the finish of the long course, refreshments at the finish of the short course
additional: Children's race is free of charge. Changing rooms, toilets, and storage are located at the port near the Bohemia Ship. Each runner must wear a visible bib number on the chest. The organizer provides medical services. Entry fee will be fully refunded if canceled by June 8. The race is conducted according to athletics competition rules and event regulations. The 13 km and 5 km courses, children's race, categories for men and women of various age groups, start from 09:45 to 10:15, parking at Bogárka, recreational resort Domaša Dobra.

name: Beh za zdravie – Záhorská Bystrica
location: BYS3T PARK, Záhorská Bystrica, Bratislava, Slovakia
description: Health Run in Záhorská Bystrica is a charitable running event that combines sports with promoting health and community. It will take place on June 27, 2026, in BYS3T PARK and offers an opportunity to experience a great atmosphere and inspiring stories, with every participant contributing to a good cause. The event is open to all age groups and fitness levels, supporting a healthy lifestyle and helping disadvantaged individuals. Health Run was established in 2023 and annually supports selected persons or foundations through movement.
course_highlights: Takes place in BYS3T PARK in Záhorská Bystrica
The event combines running and community support
Open to all age groups and fitness levels
additional: The event is charitable and supports disadvantaged individuals and organizations. Children, adults, and seniors can participate by running, walking at a slow pace, or strolling. Organizers offer the opportunity to volunteer and assist with the event organization. The event takes place on park grounds and streets in Záhorská Bystrica, with options to participate as a runner, walker, or volunteer. There is also a virtual participation option.

name: Velvet Run Košice
location: Košice, pri Urbanovej veži na Hlavnej ulici, Košice, Slovakia
organizer: Progres Promotion Košice, s.r.o., Maratónsky klub Košice
description: Velvet Run in Košice is a running event taking place on June 27, 2026, at the Urban Tower on Main Street. Participants can choose from disciplines of 5 km, 10 km, and Velvet Nordic Walking at 5 km. The event is exclusively for women and offers valuable material prizes for winners in various categories. Organizers will provide timing measurement using the MyLaps system, and results will be published on the official website.
course_highlights: Courses Velvet Run 5 km and 10 km in the center of Košice near the Urban Tower
Discipline Velvet Nordic Walking at 5 km
Presentation and start on Main Street
additional: Registration is open online until June 23, 2026, or until the limit is reached. On-site registration is also possible from 14:00, provided that technical and safety limits have not been exceeded. The announcement of winners begins at 18:00, and the event concludes at 19:00. Competitions for pairs "Mother and Daughter" and "Sisters" in 5 km and 10 km runs. Timing measurement is provided by the ChampionChip system MyLaps. The event includes various categories for different age groups, with timing using the ChampionChip system; registration is also possible on-site.

name: Čergovský umirak
location: Drienica, Sabinov District, Prešov Region, Slovakia
organizer: Marián Gargalovič, Ondrej Janiga, Slavomír Uličný

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: 25,– € Po úhrade štartovného a následnom odhlásení sa z preteku si organizátor nárokuje na 50% z ceny štartovného.

description: Čergovský umirak is a mountain run approximately 30 km long with an elevation gain of around 1000 meters, intended for trained runners. The race takes place at the recreational center Drienica, with options for refreshments and additional activities for families. The course runs along marked hiking trails, and participants are required to wear a visible start number on their chest. Safety on the course is provided by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service, and each participant runs at their own risk. After the last runners finish, there will be an evaluation and award ceremony for the best men and women.
course_highlights: Mountain run approximately 30 km long with an elevation gain of about 1000 m
Marked hiking trail in the Čergov area
Start and finish at Chata Ride pub in Drienica
additional: Mandatory equipment: charged mobile phone, minimum 0.5 liter water bottle, aluminum foil in case of bad weather. A joint briefing will be held at 8:30 AM at Chata Ride pub, including familiarization with the course and orientation. Refreshments will be provided. The start number is non-transferable and must be visibly attached to the chest. Safety during the race is secured by the Čergov Mountain Rescue Service. The course is marked as a hiking trail; trail running shoes are recommended. To register, contact the organizers by phone or email.

name: Hámornický polmaratón
description: The Hámornický Half Marathon is a traditional running race organized by the Spartak Medzev Running Club as part of the Medzev City Days celebrations. The event includes the half marathon, the accompanying Hámornícka Ten race, and children's categories Hámorníček, which are part of the children's running league. The start is symbolically marked by a hammer strike on an anvil, adding a unique atmosphere to the event. Runners can look forward to nice functional T-shirts, medals with a modern design, and refreshments during the race. The course takes place through a beautiful deep valley with natural beauty and a historic atmosphere of the town of Medzev.
course_highlights: The route passes through a beautiful deep valley with natural springs and bird songs
Symbolic start with a hammer strike on an anvil
Supporting runs including the Hámornícka Ten and children's categories Hámorníček
additional: Participants receive nice functional T-shirts and medals with a modern design. Children can participate for free in 14 categories with a package of sweets and juice at the finish line. The event is supported by the town of Medzev and the village of Štós, with organizers appreciating help from 2% of taxes. The course also includes a football stadium; registration is available online and on-site; categories for men, women, and seniors.

name: Beh cez Hornoorešanské vŕšky – Memoriál Františka Hečka
location: Futbalový štadión, Horné Orešany, Trnava, Slovakia
organizer: Bežecký klub Viktoria, Obecný úrad Horné Orešany
description: Running through the Hornoorešanské Vŕšky - František Hečko Memorial is a running race in Horné Orešany, offering a course length of 10,300 meters with an elevation gain of 100 meters. The surface of the course is a combination of asphalt and terrain in a 50:50 ratio, making the race interesting and challenging. The race is open to all age categories, from children as young as 1 year old to seniors, including men's, women's, junior, and local runners. The organizer is the Viktoria Running Club together with the Horné Orešany Municipal Office. The start for pupils is at 15:35 and for others at 17:00.
course_highlights: Length of the course 10,300 m with an elevation gain of 100 m
Course surface 50% asphalt, 50% terrain
The course runs through Hornoorešanské Vŕšky with beautiful views
additional: Start for pupils is at 15:35, for others at 17:00. Categories include all age groups from children as young as 1 year, juniors, men, and women of various age categories, including a local three-member team category. The course is approximately 10.3 km, divided into 50% asphalt and 50% terrain. Registration is available online or on-site. Start times are at 15:35 and 17:00.

name: Rajec RunTour Bratislava
description: Rajec RunTour Bratislava is a family running festival offering courses for all age groups and performance levels. Participants can choose from 3 km, 5 km, and 10 km routes, as well as children's runs over 500 and 1000 meters. The event takes place in two locations and includes a starter package with everything runners need. In addition to the race itself, there is a rich accompanying program, refreshments on the course and at the finish line, medical and guiding services, and facilities with changing rooms and storage. The entire day is designed as an experience for runners and their families, featuring a raffle and the option to engrave personal details on medals.
course_highlights: Routes of 3, 5, and 10 km for amateurs and elite runners
Children's runs over 500 and 1000 meters
Refreshment stations on the course and at the finish line, medical and guiding services
additional: Runners have access to guides with flags who help maintain pace. After the race, it is possible to have personal time and name engraved on the medal. There are showers, storage, and a rich accompanying program including a children's zone and a raffle with valuable prizes. The routes are 3, 5, and 10 km, with children's runs over 500 and 1000 meters, refreshments, showers, storage, medals, photos, a raffle, and a family atmosphere.

name: Behaj lesmi Bachledová dolina
location: Bachledová dolina, Bachledová dolina, Bachledka Ski & Sun, Slovakia
description: Run through Bachledová Dolina is a trail race in the beautiful nature of the High Tatras, offering runners a unique experience of running on soft terrain with fresh mountain air. The route passes through the Tree Top Walk, Monk's Valley, and the Spišská Magura ridge, with the start secured by a cable car. The race is part of the Run through the Forest series, which combines athletic performance with support for local families and charitable stories. Run through Bachledová Dolina is a challenge for experienced runners and beginners alike who want to experience mountain nature and unforgettable views.
course_highlights: The route passes through the Tree Top Walk
Views of the High Tatras and the Spišská Magura ridge
Start by cable car in Bachledová Dolina
additional: The race is included under UTMB Index Races with international point valuation. There is a fast section called Conti Speed Section with a chance to win a voucher for tires and a running jersey. Pre-registration and changes to the starting fee can be made online via the SportID profile or on-site at the race. The event includes eco-friendly cups, water stations, various race categories including children’s races, and offers discounts for multiple participant registrations.

name: Beh údolím Idy
location: Kultúrne stredisko, Železiarenská 9, Košice-Šaca, Košice, Slovakia
description: The Ida Valley Run is a traditional running race organized by the City District of Košice-Šaca and the village of Malá Ida. The race takes place in the pleasant environment of the cultural center in Košice-Šaca and offers the opportunity to compete in various age categories. The entry fee is symbolic, with local runners participating for free. The event is suitable for the general public and promotes an active lifestyle in the region.
course_highlights: Race runs through the Ida Valley in Košice-Šaca
Cultural center Železiarenská 9 as start and finish point
Traditional event with a long-standing history
additional: Local runners participate for free. The organizer is the City District of Košice-Šaca and the Municipality of Malá Ida. Contact the organizer: Mgr. Janka Jaššová, phone: 055/726 08 11, 055/726 08 16. The course is not specified, registration via phone or email, the event takes place at the Cultural Center on Železiarenská 9.

name: Beh na Poludňový Grúň
organizer: Občianske združenie Grúň, Chata na Grúni
description: The Noon Grúň Run is a mountain running race in the picturesque Vrátna Valley, in the Malá Fatra mountain range. The course leads through challenging mountain terrain with beautiful views of peaks such as Poludňový Grúň, Stoh, and Veľký Rozsutec. The race is ideal for nature lovers and mountain running enthusiasts who want to experience a unique atmosphere and challenge in the heart of Malá Fatra. Organizers warmly invite you to enjoy this sporting event in the beautiful environment of Terchová.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with ascent to Poludňový Grúň (1460 m)
Crossing Stoh Saddle and the area around Veľký Rozsutec
The route passes through Jánošíkove Diery with ladders and bridges
additional: Chata na Grúni is the highest situated mountain hut in Vrátna Valley, suitable for organizing courses and events. Nearby are two ski lifts with slopes equipped with artificial snow. The route passes through a national natural reserve with numerous waterfalls and bizarre rock formations. The race is part of regional sports events; registration includes a fee and parking. The start is at Vrátna Paseky at 10:00 AM.

name: Na hoľu

tiers.label: tier_1
tiers.description: Štartovné pri platbe na účet do 1.7.2026 vrátane občerstvenia a upomienkového predmetu

description: Kráľova hoľa is an ITRA-certified vertical kilometer event held at Kráľova hoľa in Horehronie. Runners start from the square in the village of Šumiac and the route goes directly along the blue tourist trail to the top of Kráľova hoľa. The event is a qualifying race for the Skyrunning World Championships 2024 and offers quality support including refreshments and medical services. Registration is open until July 1, 2026, with a participant limit, and the entry fee includes a commemorative item and refreshments.
course_highlights: The route is 5.2 km long with an elevation gain of 1035 m
Start at the square in the village of Šumiac, finish at the top of Kráľova hoľa
The trail is marked with colored ribbons on trees along the blue tourist trail
additional: Registration for competitors is from 7:00 to 9:30 AM either in front of the elementary school building or, in case of bad weather, inside the Šumiac municipal office. Participants under 15 years old must be accompanied by a legal guardian. Organizers provide transportation of dry clothing to the finish line. During the race, refreshments are available at Predné sedlo and at the finish. Mandatory equipment includes hiking gear and a bottle with fluids (minimum 0.5 liters). Protest submissions are accepted until 1:00 PM with a deposit of 50 EUR. The event also includes regional outdoor activities and emphasizes the promotion of tourism and sports in the Horehronie region.

name: Špačinský trojuholník
organizer: Obec Špačince, Bežecký klub 2001 Špačince, Základná škola s materskou školou v Špačinciach, Dobrovoľný hasičský zbor Špačince
price_range: 10 € štandardne, 5 € pre miestnych, zadarmo pre obyvateľov
description: The Spacince Triangle is a running race organized in the village of Spacince in the Trnava district. The race starts at 5:00 PM in the center of the village near the Elementary School with Kindergarten. Men compete in an absolute overall category regardless of age, and women from 40 years old. The organizers are the Municipality of Spacince, Running Club 2001 Spacince, Elementary School with Kindergarten in Spacince, and JDS Spacince. The registration fee is €10, except for local residents, who can participate for free.
course_highlights: Start in the center of Spacince near the Elementary School with Kindergarten
Categories for men in an absolute overall ranking and women from 40 years old
Organized in cooperation with local institutions and the running club
additional: Local residents have free registration. Men's categories are in an absolute overall ranking regardless of age, and women are evaluated from 40 years old. The start is in the center of the village near the Elementary School with Kindergarten. Details about the terrain are not specified; the race takes place in the village center, and registration is likely required.

name: Trail Relay Banská Štiavnica – Visegrád – štafety
location: Atletická dráha, Banská Štiavnica, Banská Štiavnica, Slovakia

description: The Banská Štiavnica - Vyšehrad Trail Relay is a unique 220 km relay race that connects two historic royal towns through the natural beauty of the Štiavnické Hills and the Danube-Ipeľ National Park. The race is designed for teams of 3, teams of 4 to 8 members, and 6-member teams, offering categories for experienced runners and larger teams. The route mainly follows hiking trails and natural reserves, allowing participants to explore cultural and historical monuments as well as natural scenery of the Slovak and Hungarian regions. Organizers emphasize fostering neighborly relations and promoting the region.
course_highlights: Route passes through Štiavnické Hills and Danube-Ipeľ National Park
Crosses historical and natural sites such as Hrad Drégely, NPR Burdov, Esztergom Basilica, and Duna-Ipoly River
220 km divided into 18 segments with varied ascents and descents
additional: The route is divided into 18 segments with varying elevation changes, crossing natural reserves and historical sites. Categories include ULTRA for experienced runners and a solo category from 2025. Registration is conducted via the website, where team captains create their team after registration. The race includes various categories such as ultra, mix, Nordic walking, and individual; registration is open from February to March 2026; the course runs through hiking and natural trails with an emphasis on experience and connecting countries.

name: Žaškovský minimaratón
description: Žaškovský minimaratón is a traditional running race held for the 55th time in the village of Žaškov in Orava. The course mainly runs along forest paths and village streets, approximately 12.4 km long with an elevation gain of around 600 meters. Runners are warmly welcomed by local residents of all ages during the race, creating a friendly and family atmosphere. This mini marathon is part of the Šípsko - Fatranské runs series and is suitable for all running enthusiasts who want to enjoy the beauty of Orava's nature and the sporting spirit.
course_highlights: Course length of 12.4 km with an elevation gain of approximately 600 m
Runs along forest paths and village streets of Žaškov
Part of the Šípsko - Fatranské runs series
additional: The course was previously routed through Dierová, later changed due to the closure of the bridge over the Orava River. Runners are welcomed by locals, with spectators of all ages including older residents. The race is part of a series of various running events in the region. The events include distances from 100 m to 12 km, with categories for children, youth, and adults. The event also features historical results and photo galleries. The race takes place in the village of Žaškov near the Orava River, with registration starting at 9:30 and the start at 11:00.

name: Cyrilometodský beh Kolonickým vrchom – Memoriál Jozefa Chomaniča

description: The Cyrilometodský Run Kolonickým vrchom - Jozef Chomanič Memorial is a running event held at the Bejvoč sports and recreational area in Kolonica, Snina district. The race offers categories for children and adults, including several age groups for men and women. The start for children's categories is at 13:30 and for adults at 15:00. The event is associated with the Jozef Chomanič Memorial and provides an opportunity for participants of all ages to test their strength in a beautiful natural environment.
course_highlights: The race takes place at the Bejvoč sports and recreational area in Kolonica
Multiple age categories for men and women, including children
Children's start at 13:30, adults at 15:00
additional: Categories: children, Men A (up to 39 years), B (40-49 years), C (50-59 years), D (60+), Women E (up to 39 years), F (40+), Jozef Chomanič Memorial for men and women. Contact: Pavol A. Dubovský (var@kozmos.sk), Kamila Chomaničová (phone: 0902 587 389). Registration is possible online or on-site. The race is part of a commemorative event with various age categories.

name: Domašská desiatka na Eve
location: Domaša pri Vranove nad Topľou, Vranov nad Topľou, Prešov, Slovakia

tiers.label: tier_1
