name: Psotkov memoriál
location: Štrbské Pleso, Vysoké Tatry, Prešovský kraj, Slovakia
description: Psotko's Memorial is a traditional mountain running race in the Tatra Mountains, held in Štrbské Pleso. The race offers two challenging routes - BASIC with a length of 25.3 km and an elevation gain of +1540 m, and EXTREME with a length of 37.9 km and an elevation gain of +2490 m. The routes pass through beautiful mountain scenery, including the surroundings of Kriváň, Jamské Pleso, and Furkotská Valley, and are intended for experienced runners with good fitness. The race is part of the Skyrunner® National Series Slovakia 2026 and is limited to 400 participants.
course_highlights: The route passes over Štrbské Pleso and below the summit of Kriváň
Refreshment stations at Tri Studničky and near the lower station of the cable car
Beautiful mountain trails along Jamské Pleso and Furkotská Valley
additional: Registration is limited to 400 participants (200 for BASIC and 200 for EXTREME). Members of the Slovak Mountaineering Association James receive a discount on the entry fee. The EXTREME route is run as a timed race. The time limit for BASIC is 6 hours, for EXTREME 8 hours. The start and finish are in the SNOW cross-country skiing area - Štrba, Štrbské Pleso. Registration is open from June 1 to September 30, 2025; limit of 400 participants; the registration fee includes refreshments, a commemorative badge, and trail security; course parameters and mountain insurance are included.

The event is part of the Running League Michalovce - Sobrance 2025 and offers categories for various age groups and Nordic walking.

Course runs through the natural environment of Vihorlat
Start and finish at the football field (amphitheater) in Poruba pod Vihorlatom

description: The Extreme Oščadnica Marathon is a mountain marathon set amidst the picturesque nature of Kysuce, mainly along mountain ridges offering beautiful views of Veľká Rača. The event is not a race but an experiential run that emphasizes the joy of movement, friendship, and willpower. Organizers provide complete services including refreshments, a T-shirt, and a communal gathering after the run.

Refreshment stations approximately every 8 km

Registration is only possible online, or on-site if the start list is not full. Registration closes once the limit of 200 participants is reached. The registration fee includes a T-shirt, storage, showers, on-trail and finish line refreshments, a medal, and an after-party. Registration is possible online, with a participant limit of 200, and includes a T-shirt, refreshments, a medal, and an after-party.

Atmosphere among helicopters and military equipment with an army style

description: Slaňaki CUP - Uphill Run Dubník is a traditional uphill race held in Zámutov, Vranov nad Topľou district. The race offers a challenge for runners who want to test their endurance and strength in demanding mountain terrain.

name: Beh oslobodenia Kálnice
description: The Liberation Run in Kálnica is a traditional running race organized by the municipality of Kálnica in honor of the fallen Romanian soldiers during the liberation of the village. The race takes place on a route from Kálnica to Rakoľúby and back, with various distances for different age categories. The surface of the course is asphalt, flat with slight elevation and turns. The event is suitable for the general public, including children, who can run accompanied by an adult. The start of the race is at the Cultural House in Kálnica.
course_highlights: Route Kálnica - Rakoľúby - Kálnica
Distances: 1500 m, 5500 m, and 11000 m
Asphalt surface with slight elevation of 36 m
additional: Online registration ends on 10.4.2025 at 23:55 or when the participant limit is reached. After this date, registration on-site on the day of the race is possible if the limit has not been exceeded. Paid entry fee is non-refundable but can be transferred to another person via the account on vysledkovyservis.sk or for a handling fee of 4 € without an account. The course is asphalt, flat with slight elevation; registration is possible online until 10.4.2025; the entry fee includes refreshments and a raffle; the race takes place on 11 April 2026.

name: Zvolenská Corrida
location: Námestie SNP, Zvolen, Banskobystrický kraj, Slovakia
organizer: Mesto Zvolen, Mišo s. r. o.
description: Zvolen Race is a running event held on the pedestrian zone of SNP Square in Zvolen. Participants run five laps of 1 km each on a flat course, totaling 5 km. The event also includes children's races and a family fun run with no registration fee. The event is part of the Zvolen Running League and offers professional organization and timing.
course_highlights: A 1,000 m loop on the pedestrian zone of SNP Square
Flat course suitable for all age groups
A total of 5 laps, i.e., 5 km for the main race
additional: Children's races are free of charge, with categories based on age and distances of 50 m, 250 m, and 500 m. The Mama/Oco Race is a family fun run with a length of 1 km, also free of charge. Registration for the main race is conducted electronically until capacity of 200 participants is reached; children's races and the Mama/Oco Race register on-site from 9:00 AM. The program includes a presentation, children's races starting at 10:00, the Mama/Oco Race at 10:30, the main race at 11:00, and awards at 12:00 with a raffle. The event features the main 5 km race, children's runs, and family runs, with online or on-site registration, medals for the first 170 participants, and the main race starting around 11:00 AM.

name: Furčiansky maratón – Memoriál Štefana Semana
description: The Furčiansky Marathon - Memorial of Štefan Semana is a traditional running marathon organized by the O5 Running Club Furča Košice. This 23rd edition will take place on April 11, 2026, in Košice and offers runners the opportunity to test their strength on a certified course. The marathon is known for its community atmosphere and support for running activities in the region. Organizers welcome all runners who want to experience a quality and well-prepared marathon.
course_highlights: marathon, relay categories
traditional event with history
location in Košice with excellent atmosphere
additional: Online results are available from 10:00 AM on the day of the race. Registration for the Furčiansky Marathon 2026 has closed. The organizer is O5 Running Club Furča Košice. The event includes a marathon, an extreme marathon, and relay races, with various age categories and registration fees. It also features a memorial to Štefan Semana and supports the running community.

name: Jarný beh Michalovčanov
organizer: Mesto Michalovce, Atletický klub Michalovce, Stredná odborná škola technická
price_range: 2 € dospelí, 1 € mládež do 18 rokov, 0 € muži nad 70 rokov a ženy nad 60 rokov
description: Spring Run of Michalovce Residents is a traditional running race held on Saturday, April 11, 2026, in Michalovce at V. Elementary School on Školská Street. Participants can look forward to competitions in various age categories, including children up to 9 years old, who run 400 meters. The event is suitable for the general public and offers a pleasant atmosphere of a spring sports day with results announcement and medal awards.
course_highlights: Start and finish at V. Elementary School, Školská 2, Michalovce
Running courses for different age groups
Short race of 400 m for children up to 9 years old
additional: The event program includes the start of the 400 m race at 9:30 for boys' and girls' categories up to 9 years old and the results announcement with medal awards at 10:30. The children's race begins at 10:00, the main race at 10:15; registration fee covers various age categories; the venue is Michalovce, V. Elementary School, ŠKOLSKÁ 2.

name: ČSOB Bratislava marathon – desiatka, Minimaratón, deti, lezúni
description: ČSOB Bratislava Marathon is a family running event with a long-standing tradition held in Bratislava, attracting runners from Slovakia and abroad. It offers various disciplines from the marathon, half marathon, relay races, to the 10K, mini marathon, children's runs, and climbing competitions. The atmosphere is full of emotions, fair play, and camaraderie, where everyone who lines up at the start and surpasses themselves is a winner. The event also supports charitable activities and emphasizes the value of mutual help and solidarity.
course_highlights: Marathon course with a length of 42.195 km in the center of Bratislava
10K race with Mattoni and Garmin Run Series Mini Marathon as shorter disciplines
Children's runs and climbing competitions for the youngest runners
additional: The start of the 10K race with Mattoni is on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 16:00, the Garmin Run Series Mini Marathon starts on Saturday, 11.04.2026 at 14:00, and children's runs begin on Saturday, 11.04.2026 from 10:00 according to age categories. Relay races have specific start numbers with chips for timing measurement. Participant limits are set for individual disciplines (e.g., 2000 for the 10K, 1500 for the mini marathon and children's runs). The races take place in Bratislava, with registrations open at various prices. The course includes city streets and the attractive environment of Eurovea Galleria.

name: Kysucká desiatka
organizer: Mestské kulturno-športové stredisko Kysucké Nové Mesto
description: Kysucká desiatka is a running race in Kysucké Nové Mesto offering courses for various age groups including pupils and adults. The race starts in the western part of Murgašova Street, with participants competing on a 1 km course for pupils or a 10 km course for adults and juniors. The event is organized by the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center of Kysucké Nové Mesto and features categories based on age and gender. The start for pupils is at 10:05 AM and for other categories at 10:30 AM. The race is suitable for a wide running community and promotes sports life in the region.
course_highlights: Course runs through the western part of Murgašova Street in Kysucké Nové Mesto
Available categories for pupils on 1 km and for adults on 10 km
Categories divided by age and gender including juniors and junior girls
additional: The start for pupils is at 10:05 AM, and for categories of men, women, juniors, and junior girls at 10:30 AM. The organizer is the Municipal Cultural and Sports Center of Kysucké Nové Mesto. Contact person: Renáta Kováčiková, phone: 0902 405 190. The start location for the 10 km race is in the western part of Murgašova Street. The race includes categories for children, juniors, men, and women, starting from 10:05 to 10:30; the course runs through the streets of Kysucké Nové Mesto, registration is possible online or on-site.

name: Majstrovstvá SR v maratóne mužov a žien, veteránov a veteránok (ČSOB Bratislava maratón 2026) (4.kolo BP SAZ)
description: Slovak National Championships in the marathon for men and women, veterans, and veteran women is a significant athletics event taking place in Bratislava. Competitors can look forward to a well-prepared course and professional organization under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation. The event is part of a series of races and offers the opportunity to compete in various categories, including veterans. Registration is conducted online and is open to the broad running community.
course_highlights: Marathon course in Bratislava with a city character
Races for men, women, and veterans in various categories
Organized under the auspices of the Slovak Athletic Federation
additional: Registration is conducted online and must be completed by April 7, 2026, at 12:00 PM. Starting numbers are issued to team leaders during the registration at the race office. Warm-up is permitted outside the competition track. Changing rooms are available for boys and girls. Official results will be published on the Slovak Athletic Federation's website. The event is part of the ČSOB Bratislava Marathon 2026 and is intended for all age categories, including veterans.
sources: http://statistika.atletika.sk/admin/media/propozice/MAJSTROVSTVA SR v maratone - propozicie_12.4.2026, Bratislava akt..pdf

name: Trenčianská bežecká liga – 2. kolo
description: The Trenčín Running League is a series of nine running events organized since 2015 around Trenčín, intended for the general public including competitive runners and enthusiasts. Each month from March to November, one round takes place on various interesting and diverse routes. The races offer a friendly atmosphere, motivation, and an opportunity to meet people who support a healthy lifestyle. Results and scoring after each round serve as motivation for further training and performance improvement.
course_highlights: Course 8.95 km with an elevation gain of 130 m in Trenčianske Stankovce, mostly terrain with 20% asphalt
Routes pass through field roads, a dam around a pond, village roads, and hills
Start and finish at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce
additional: Registration and check-in take place directly on site from 9:00 AM. The start fee is paid on site. Runners can contribute a voluntary donation to the United Boarding School in Trenčín. Running with a dog is allowed, but a runner with a dog receives 1 point for participation without scoring based on placement. The league round is held at the football field in Trenčianske Stankovce. The event promotes community and a healthy lifestyle, suitable for all age groups and running levels.
